activities.description:
The Vex are testing CloudArk defenses in this region. Reality fractures as the VexNet bleeds through into Neomuna.

In the Vex Incursion Zone, Vex will appear in greater numbers and Strand energy sources will temporarily increase Strand ability recovery. 

Rarely, the Vex will succeed in disabling the CloudArk's defenses, and the elite Vex strike force will deploy a concentrated assault.
activities.descriptionZh:
Vex正在这片区域试探云端方舟的防御系统。Vex网络渗透进了内欧姆那，现实随之破裂。

在Vex入侵区，Vex将会以更多的数量出现，而缚丝能量源将会暂时提升缚丝技能恢复速度。

极少数情况下，Vex会成功摧毁云端方舟的防御系统，而精锐的Vex打击小队将部署集中攻击。

activities.descriptionZh: 在发射基地搜索一个秘密藏货。找到它来领取你的奖励。

activities.name: Midtown
activities.description: The Last City, Earth
activities.descriptionZh: 地球，最后的城市

activities.name: Widow's Court
activities.description: European Dead Zone, Earth
activities.descriptionZh: 欧洲无人区，地球

activities.name: Vox Obscura: Customize
activities.description: A Psionic propaganda transmission threatens to destabilize the Vanguard's Cabal allies. Breach the rebel stronghold to discover who's behind the new Psionic offensive.
activities.descriptionZh: 一则灵能宣传通讯威胁到了先锋的卡巴尔盟友。攻破叛军据点，找出新灵能攻势的幕后黑手。

activities.name: The Glassway: Matchmade
activities.description: Eramis activated the Vex portal once built by Clovis Bray. The Exo Stranger asks for your help in stopping the Vex incursion to Europa.
activities.descriptionZh: 伊拉莫斯激活了克洛维斯·布瑞以前建造的Vex传送门。Exo陌客请你帮忙阻止Vex入侵木卫二。

activities.name: Moth-Infested Cavern
activities.description: Traverse a treacherous cave full of deadly moths.
activities.descriptionZh: 穿越满是致命飞蛾的险恶洞穴。

activities.name: Heroic Strikes Playlist
activities.description: Launches a random Destiny 2 Heroic strike without expansion content.
activities.descriptionZh: 随机启动一个《命运2》非扩充内容中的英雄打击。

activities.name: The Lightblade: Matchmade
activities.description: Recover an artifact from a monument to Oryx, located deep in the swamps of Savathûn's throne world.
activities.descriptionZh: 前往位于萨瓦图恩王座世界沼泽深处的欧里克斯纪念碑，取回一件神器。

activities.name: Major Fieldwork VII
activities.description: Help Eido with tonic research by participating in major fieldwork on the Moon.
activities.descriptionZh: 通过在月球上参与主要外勤工作，帮助艾多进行药剂研究。

activities.name: Artesia Mons, Venus: Sabotage: Matchmade
activities.nameZh: 金星，阿蒂西亚山：破坏: 匹配
activities.description: Sabotage hostile assets at Artesia Mons on Venus.
activities.descriptionZh: 在金星的阿蒂西亚山破坏敌方资产。

activities.name: Savathûn's Spire (Legend)
activities.description: Gather your coven to master this Legend challenge. Empower the Witch Queen's Spire and face the experiments within.
activities.descriptionZh: 召集你的女巫会，完成这个传说挑战。向巫妖女王的尖塔提供能量，面对其中的各种试验品。

activities.name: Guardian Games: Supremacy: Matchmade
activities.nameZh: 守护者游戏：霸权: 匹配
activities.description: In Guardian Games: Supremacy, Guardians are teamed up with other Guardians of the same class.
activities.descriptionZh: 在守护者游戏：霸权中，守护者将与同一职业的其他守护者进行组队。

activities.name: The Arms Dealer
activities.description: Shut down the operations of an ironmonger providing weapons to the Red Legion.
activities.descriptionZh: 终止向猩红军团提供武器的军械商的行为。

activities.name: The Coil: The Coil (Matchmade)
activities.description: Delve ever deeper into the myriad pathways of Riven's Lair in The Coil. Face greater challenges and retrieve greater rewards.
activities.descriptionZh: 在盘蜷中深入魅痕巢穴交错的通路，面对更大的挑战，获得更丰厚的奖励。

activities.name: STRANDED
activities.description: Peer into the past with Ikora to learn about Strand and the Witness's plans on Neptune.
activities.descriptionZh: 与艾可拉一起回顾往昔，了解缚丝和见证者对海王星的计划。

activities.name: Nightfall Grandmaster: Heist Battleground: Mars
activities.nameZh: 宗师日落: 盗劫战场：火星
activities.description: Heist Battleground: Mars
activities.descriptionZh: 盗劫战场：火星

activities.name: Legend: Mothyards: Onslaught
activities.nameZh: 传说：飞蛾庭院: 猛攻
activities.description: Defend Vanguard forces with the Advanced Defensive Unit against an onslaught of 50 combatant waves.
activities.descriptionZh: 使用高级防御单元保护先锋部队，抵抗50波战斗人员的猛攻。

activities.name: Skip New Light
activities.description: Fly straight to the Tower to skip the New Light tutorial and join the Vanguard on the frontlines to combat the foes of humanity.
activities.descriptionZh: 直接飞往高塔，跳过新曙光教程，到前线随先锋对抗人类之敌。

activities.name: Tomb of Elders: Private
activities.description: Don't let the Prison of Elders become your tomb. Survive a series of grueling challenges. Escape with your life— the riches are just a bonus.
activities.descriptionZh: 别让长老监狱成为你的坟墓，撑过一系列艰苦挑战。活着逃出去最重要，奖品只是锦上添花而已。

activities.name: Ketchcrash: Customize
activities.nameZh: 双桅船交锋: 自定义
activities.description: Ship-to-ship combat with the most ferocious pirates in the Sol system.
activities.descriptionZh: 与最为凶残的海盗在太阳系中进行舰对舰作战。

activities.name: (Heroic) Postmodern Prometheus
activities.description: Ikora is reluctantly allowing Asher to explore a plan where he'd convert the Traveler's energy into a form of synthetic Light.
activities.descriptionZh: 阿什想要将旅行者的能量转换为合成光能的形式，艾可拉无奈应允了他的研究计划。

activities.name: Bannerfall
activities.description: The Last City, Earth
activities.descriptionZh: 地球，最后的城市

activities.name: Quickplay: Master
activities.description: A rotating selection of activities at a higher difficulty level.
activities.descriptionZh: 一组更高难度等级的轮换活动。

activities.nameZh: 入侵: 木卫二，帝国锻造矩阵：破坏

activities.descriptionZh: 在盘蜷中深入魅痕巢穴交错的通路，面对更大的挑战，获得更丰厚的奖励。

activities.name: Exodus Crash: Customize
activities.nameZh: 移民号的坠毁: 自定义
activities.description: Purge the Vex and Fallen, who have overrun the Exodus Black crash site.
activities.descriptionZh: 清除占领黑色移民号坠毁现场的Vex和堕落者。

activities.name: The Message, Part III
activities.description: Journey into the depths of the Pale Heart and commune with the Traveler.
activities.descriptionZh: 前往苍白之心深处，并与旅行者交流。

activities.name: Destiny 2: Shadowkeep
activities.description: New nightmares have emerged from the shadows of our Moon. Called forth by haunting visions, Eris Morn has returned. Join her to slay these nightmares before they reach out beyond the Moon to cast humanity back into an age of darkness.
activities.descriptionZh: 新的梦魇自月球的阴影中浮现。受到挥之不去的幻影召唤，埃里斯·摩恩回来了。快来与她并肩作战，在梦魇自月球袭来，将人类文明拖回黑暗时代之前，把它们通通消灭。

activities.name: The Inverted Spire
activities.description: End the Red Legion expedition that's ripped open the planet's surface.
activities.descriptionZh: 结束撕裂行星地表的猩红军团远征行动。

activities.name: Charge: Legendary
activities.description: Restore power to an inactive reactor to provide for the Aionian Campus.
activities.descriptionZh: 恢复一个未启用反应堆的电力，为艾昂校园提供能源。

activities.name: In the Deep
activities.description:
Somewhere in the horrific depths of the Hellmouth lies the Hive Cryptoglyph. With it, Eris Morn can craft further Dreambane armor for your quest to find a way inside the Pyramid.

The Cryptoglyph is yours to take from the Hive… if you can.
activities.descriptionZh:
在地狱深渊之下的某处，藏有一块邪魔族秘符。有了它，埃里斯·摩恩就能打造出更多梦境祸根护甲，从而帮助你找到进入金字塔的路。

秘符正等待着你将它从邪魔族的手中夺走……如果你有这个能力的话。

activities.name: Gambit: Matchmade
activities.description: Defeat the enemies of humanity, collect their Motes, and bank them to summon a Primeval. First team to destroy their Primeval wins.
activities.descriptionZh: 消灭人类的敌人，收集其掉落的萤光，并将它们存放入库以召唤古昧。第一个消灭古昧的团队获胜。

activities.name: The Burnout
activities.description: Vex Future, Infinite Forest
activities.descriptionZh: 无尽森林，Vex未来

activities.name: Cathedral of Scars
activities.description: The Dreaming City, The Vestian Web
activities.descriptionZh: 幽梦之城，灶神罗网

activities.name: Freehold Outskirts, Mars: Bounty Hunt: Private
activities.nameZh: 火星自由地带市郊：悬赏猎杀: 私人
activities.description: Hunt a notorious outlaw and secure their bounty at Freehold Outskirts, Mars.
activities.descriptionZh: 在火星的自由地带市郊追猎一名声名狼藉的不法之徒并获取其悬赏。

activities.name: The Nether: Advanced
activities.description: Journey aboard the Dreadnaught to discover secrets in the gloam.
activities.descriptionZh: 登上无畏战舰，探索幽暗之处的秘密。

activities.name: Ascent: Legendary
activities.description: Join Cayde and Crow on a journey to cross an impassible divide.
activities.descriptionZh: 与凯德和乌鸦一起踏上旅程，跨越不可逾越的鸿沟。

activities.name: Rusted Lands
activities.description: Eastern Flood Zone, Earth
activities.descriptionZh: 东方洪水区，地球

activities.name: Private Match Limited
activities.description: REWARDS ENABLED! Create a custom PvP match with your fireteam, and best your comrades for personal glory… and bragging rights.
activities.descriptionZh: 奖励已启用！创建自定义PvP比赛，与火力战队和好友一起，为荣誉…和炫耀的资本而战。

activities.name: Checkmate Control
activities.description:
Achieve victory by capturing zones and defeating opponents.

Ability and Primary ammo damage is reduced. Special ammo is earned by engaging in combat and is not lost on death.
activities.descriptionZh:
通过占领区域并击败对手来取得胜利。

技能和主弹药伤害降低。特殊弹药需通过交战获得，死亡时不会丢失。

• 今日在塔尔西斯革新会控制的地盘上，可提取物有几率包含双倍奖励。

activities.descriptionZh: 随机启动一个《命运2》、《冥王诅咒》或《战争思维》中的打击。

activities.name: WANTED: Silent Fang
activities.description: Hunt down the wanted Silent Fang who escaped from the Prison of Elders.
activities.descriptionZh: 追猎逃离长老监狱的通缉犯寂牙。

activities.name: WANTED: Gravetide Summoner
activities.description: Hunt down the wanted Gravetide Summoner who escaped from the Prison of Elders.
activities.descriptionZh: 追猎逃离长老监狱的通缉犯墓潮召唤者。

activities.name: Nightmare Containment
activities.description: Draw out and defeat powerful Nightmares to imprison them with the Nightmare Harvester.
activities.descriptionZh: 引出并击败强大的梦魇，用梦魇收割者囚禁他们。

activities.name: The Reckoning
activities.description: Venture into the mysterious Haul that the Drifter tows behind his ship to reckon with greater powers.
activities.descriptionZh: 进入浪客飞船后面拖着的神秘曳室，算算自己能否获得更高的能量。

activities.description: Infinite Forest, Mercury

activities.descriptionZh: 与队友并肩作战，粉碎对手。

activities.name: The Moon
activities.description: An ancient evil stirs beneath the shattered surface of our Moon.
activities.descriptionZh: 一个古老的恶魔在我们月球的破碎地表之下骚动。

activities.description: Transmat to Ahimsa Park with your fellow Guardians to combat the grid-shattering chaos of Terminal Overload!
activities.descriptionZh: 和你的守护者同伴传送至非暴力公园，一起对抗终端过载的电网碎裂乱象！

activities.name: Leviathan: Prestige
activities.description: "Grow fat from strength."
activities.descriptionZh: “又壮又强。”

activities.name: //node.ovrd.AVALON//
activities.description: Investigate a Vex network node in the EDZ that has been overwritten with a single word: AVALON.
activities.descriptionZh: 调查欧洲无人区中的一个Vex网络节点，该节点已被一个词覆盖：阿瓦隆。

activities.name: Schism
activities.description: Work with Shaw to find his missing teammates.
activities.descriptionZh: 和韩潇一起找到他迷失的队友。

activities.name: Cutting Edge: Rumble: Matchmade
activities.nameZh: 尖端装备：混战: 匹配
activities.description:
Cutting Edge: Only New Gear permitted. New Gear also grants reward bonuses.

Achieve victory by defeating opponents. No teams. No allegiances. A free-for-all where the leader had better watch their back.
activities.descriptionZh:
尖端装备：只允许使用新装备，且新装备提供奖励加成。

击败对手以获得胜利。没有队伍。无需忠诚。在混战中，领先者最好多加小心。

activities.name: The Conflux
activities.description: Drive out enemies trying to anchor themselves on Nessus.
activities.descriptionZh: 驱逐试图在涅索斯立足的敌人。

activities.nameZh: 火星，赫拉斯坚垒：走私: 匹配
activities.description: Smuggle contraband from Hellas Fortitude, Mars.
activities.descriptionZh: 从火星的赫拉斯坚垒走私违禁品。

activities.description:

activities.name: The Technocrat: Matchmade
activities.description: Defeat Eramis's technology expert, Praksis, the Technocrat.
activities.descriptionZh: 击败伊拉莫斯的技术专家普拉克西斯。

activities.name: Legacy: Forsaken: Last Call
activities.nameZh: 传统：遗落之族: 最后一战
activities.description: Fight alongside Cayde-6 to help Petra Venj regain control of the dangerous Prison of Elders.
activities.descriptionZh: 与凯德6号并肩作战，帮助佩特拉·万吉重新掌控危机四伏的长老监狱。

activities.name: Nightfall: Strange Terrain
activities.description: Defeat Nokris before he completes his ritual.
activities.descriptionZh: 在诺克里斯完成仪式前将其击败。

activities.name: Trail of the Hunted
activities.description: Join Osiris on the Moon in his hunt for vengeance.
activities.descriptionZh: 到月球上与奥斯里斯一起展开他的复仇之旅。

activities.name: Caiatl
activities.description: Empress of the Cabal
activities.descriptionZh: 卡巴尔女帝

activities.name: Battleground: Oracle
activities.description: A group of former Red Legion Psions are communing with Vex prediction engines deep within Nessus. They seek to gain tactical insights by analyzing simulations of future events against their own psychic foresight.  Eliminate this threat before they can deliver their intelligence to Empress Caiatl.
activities.descriptionZh: 一群原属猩红军团的灵能士兵在涅索斯深处与Vex预言引擎进行交流。他们想通过分析针对他们自身灵能预感的未来事件模拟来取得战术优势。在他们将情报传回给查厄托女王之前，消灭这个威胁。

activities.name: K1 Logistics
activities.description: Missions curated for fireteams of one.
activities.descriptionZh: 为单人火力战队特选的任务。

activities.name: Distant Shore
activities.description: Arcadian Strand, Nessus
activities.descriptionZh: 涅索斯，阿卡狄亚滨岸

activities.name: High Plains Blues
activities.description: Search the Tangled Shore for Cayde's killers.
activities.descriptionZh: 在纷争海岸寻找杀害凯德的凶手。

activities.name: Radiant Cliffs
activities.description: Mercury's Past, Infinite Forest
activities.descriptionZh: 旧日水星，无尽森林

activities.name: Overthrown
activities.description: The Light once more flows freely through the Blooming and the Witness's forces are in retreat.
activities.descriptionZh: 光能再次自由流经繁盛之地，见证者的部队撤退了。

activities.name: The Inverted Spire
activities.description: End the Red Legion expedition that's ripped open the planet's surface.
activities.descriptionZh: 结束撕裂行星地表的猩红军团远征行动。

activities.name: Ketchcrash
activities.description: Ship-to-ship combat with the most ferocious pirates in the Sol system.
activities.descriptionZh: 与最为凶残的海盗在太阳系中进行舰对舰作战。

activities.descriptionZh: 从你的报仇名单上划去名为骗术师的嗤魅公爵，为凯德的死报仇。

activities.description: Unique reward space for the best of the best. You must be found worthy by achieving 7 wins with no losses to gain access.

activities.name: Home, Part II
activities.description: With Zavala facing a crisis of faith, join Caiatl on a mission to restore his hope and destroy a Shadow Legion operation in the Divide.
activities.descriptionZh: 萨瓦拉面临着信仰危机，与查厄托一起执行任务，摧毁暗影军团在分歧之地的行动，让萨瓦拉重拾希望。

activities.description: Navigate and traverse the Vex structures at the core of Nessus.
activities.descriptionZh: 穿行并走出位于涅索斯核心的Vex建筑。

activities.name: Court of Blades (Blood of Oryx): Expert
activities.nameZh: 利刃大厅（欧里克斯之血）: 专家
activities.description: Take on all challengers to sword logic in Oryx's old Court on the Dreadnaught.
activities.descriptionZh: 在无畏战舰欧里克斯的旧日大厅中迎战所有邪剑守则的挑战者。

activities.name: Cliffhanger
activities.description: Asher has information about the Vex's next conversion site, and he wants it stopped.
activities.descriptionZh: 阿什有关于Vex下一个转换站点的信息，他想要阻止转换的发生。

activities.name: Piker Gang Territory
activities.description:
No Bonus Active

Complete a Priority Contract in a Contested Territory to earn its Fortified Territory bonus the following day.
activities.descriptionZh:
暂无生效加成

在必争之地完成一份首要合约，即可于次日获得其强化地盘加成。

activities.name: Nightfall: Exodus Crash
activities.description: Purge the Fallen infestation of the Exodus Black.
activities.descriptionZh: 清除黑色移民号上的堕落者分泌物。

activities.name: Nightfall: The Pyramidion
activities.description: Seek vengeance against the Vex Mind that corrupted Asher's arm.
activities.descriptionZh: 向腐化阿什手臂的Vex思维复仇。

activities.name: Arena: Breach Executable: Standard
activities.nameZh: 竞技场：可执行突破: 标准
activities.description: Set out to investigate Vex disturbances on an awakening Nessus. Extract data for research, and discover the secrets our foes keep.
activities.descriptionZh: 出发调查在觉醒的涅索斯上出现的Vex动乱。提取研究需要的数据，揭开敌人所守护的秘密。

activities.name: Artesia Mons, Venus: Smuggle: Matchmade
activities.nameZh: 金星，阿蒂西亚山：走私: 匹配
activities.description: Smuggle contraband from Artesia Mons on Venus.
activities.descriptionZh: 从金星的阿蒂西亚山走私违禁品。

activities.name: Rushdown Warm-Up
activities.description: Smash your way through a curated selection of iconic encounters before the timer expires.
activities.descriptionZh: 在时间结束前，在一系列经典遭遇战中一路过关斩将。

activities.name: Enthymeme
activities.description: Crawl through the Divining Halls in Riven's Lair and retrieve her clutch.
activities.descriptionZh: 穿过魅痕巢穴的占卜厅区域并取回她的蛋。

activities.name: Exodus Crash: Matchmade
activities.nameZh: 移民号的坠毁: 匹配
activities.description: Purge the Vex and Fallen, who have overrun the Exodus Black crash site.
activities.descriptionZh: 清除占领黑色移民号坠毁现场的Vex和堕落者。

activities.name: Selina Morass, Venus: Smuggle: Matchmade
activities.nameZh: 金星，塞琳娜沼泽：走私: 匹配
activities.description: Smuggle contraband from Selina Morass on Venus.
activities.descriptionZh: 从金星的塞琳娜沼泽走私违禁品。

activities.name: Battleground: Conduit
activities.description: Follow the flow of Vex radiolaria deep within Nessus.
activities.descriptionZh: 跟随涅索斯深处的Vex活性放射体液的流动。

activities.name: Onslaught: Playlist
activities.description: Defend Vanguard forces with the Advanced Defensive Unit against an onslaught of 10 combatant waves.
activities.descriptionZh: 使用高级防御单元保护先锋部队，抵抗10波战斗人员的猛攻。

activities.name: Exotic mission "Derealize"
activities.description: Investigate the source of a mysterious Taken power—and claim it before anyone else can.
activities.descriptionZh: 调查一股神秘傀儡之力的源头——并抢在他人之前获取它。

activities.name: Savathûn's Song
activities.description: Delve deep into the Hive-infested Arcology in search of missing fireteams.
activities.descriptionZh: 深入遭受邪魔族感染的生态园区，寻找失散的火力战队。

activities.name: Override: The Moon
activities.description: Use teamwork and your Splicer skills to force your way into the Vex network and crash it from the inside.
activities.descriptionZh: 用团队合作以及你的熔岩军团技能闯入Vex网络，从内部将其破坏。

activities.name: Expedition: Nessus: Matchmade
activities.description: Dig up buried pirate riches on Nessus, fight off raiders, and deliver the treasure haul to your Ketch!
activities.descriptionZh: 挖出深埋在涅索斯的海盗宝藏，击退突袭者，并将宝藏堆运回你的双桅船！

activities.name: Encore (Expert)
activities.description: Explore the strange structures at the core of Nessus, converted by the Vex at the Conductor's command.
activities.descriptionZh: 探索位于涅索斯核心的奇特建筑，它是Vex奉指挥者之命转化而成的。

activities.name: Expert: Kell's Grave: Onslaught: Salvation
activities.nameZh: 专家：凯尔墓穴: 猛攻：救赎
activities.description: Defend Eliksni with the Advanced Defensive Unit against 50 combatant waves.
activities.descriptionZh: 使用高级防御单元帮助埃里克斯尼族抵抗50波战斗人员的进攻。

activities.name: A Garden World
activities.description: Help Osiris cut back an out-of-control Vex Mind.
activities.descriptionZh: 帮助奥斯里斯削弱失控的Vex思维。

activities.name: The Arrival: Normal
activities.description: Track Savathûn on Mars, where temporal abnormalities scar the planet's surface and the Cabal seek to claim new territory.
activities.descriptionZh: 在火星上追踪萨瓦图恩，那里不仅被时空异常所摧残，还前有来开辟疆土的卡巴尔。

activities.name: Rumble
activities.description: Achieve victory by defeating opponents. No teams. No allegiance. A free-for-all where the leader had better watch their back.
activities.descriptionZh: 击败对手，以获得胜利。没有队伍。无需忠诚。在混战中，领先者最好多加小心。

activities.descriptionZh: 狂热者回来了。消灭他，完成由你开始的工作。

activities.descriptionZh: 与凯德6号并肩作战，帮助佩特拉·万吉重新掌控危机四伏的长老监狱。

activities.description: Despite the Vanguard's recent victories, a dissident Psion faction continues to release Darkness-inspired propaganda. Return to Mars and learn how far the conspiracy goes.
activities.descriptionZh: 尽管先锋最近取得了胜利，持不同政见的灵能士兵阵营还在继续发布受暗影影响的宣传。回到火星去，查明这场阴谋的规模到底有多大。

activities.descriptionZh: 前往被光能庇佑的萨瓦图恩王座世界，调查她是如何得到光能的。

activities.name: Battleground: Foothold
activities.description: In an act of vengeance for the destruction of their homeworld, the Cabal have struck out against a Hive nest dug deep into the Cosmodrome. Use this opportunity to hit the Cabal hard and show them that humanity will not back down.
activities.descriptionZh: 为了报复对自身母星的毁灭，卡巴尔袭击了位于发射基地地下深处的一处邪魔族巢穴。利用这个机会给予卡巴尔沉重打击，告诉他们人类是不会退缩的。

activities.name: Battleground: Oracle
activities.description: A group of former Red Legion Psions are communing with Vex prediction engines deep within Nessus. They seek to gain tactical insights by analyzing simulations of future events against their own psychic foresight.  Eliminate this threat before they can deliver their intelligence to Empress Caiatl.
activities.descriptionZh: 一群原属猩红军团的灵能士兵在涅索斯深处与Vex预言引擎进行交流。他们想通过分析针对他们自身灵能预感的未来事件模拟来取得战术优势。在他们将情报传回给查厄托女王之前，消灭这个威胁。

activities.nameZh: 守护者游戏：多人竞技日落: 高级

activities.descriptionZh: 扼杀向暗影军团提供武器的著名军械商的传承。

activities.name: European Aerial Zone: [Void] [Stasis] Day
activities.description:
Equip your Void or Stasis subclass and weapons to generate corresponding orbs. Collect them to become empowered by the element of the final orb collected.

Void empowerment grants invisibility while crouching, Truesight, and enhanced ability energy regeneration.

Stasis empowerment reduces Super energy drain and defeated combatants spawn exploding Stasis crystals.
activities.descriptionZh:
装备虚空或冰影分支职业和武器以生成对应的能量球。收集能量球可获得你所收集的最后一个能量球的元素赋能。

虚空赋能可提供蹲伏时的隐身效果和真视效果，以及技能能量恢复强化。

冰影赋能可降低超能能量的消耗，且消灭战斗人员会生成冰影水晶，冰影水晶会爆炸。

activities.name: Terminal Overload: ZC
activities.description: Transmat to Zephyr Concourse with your fellow Guardians to combat the grid-shattering chaos of Terminal Overload!
activities.descriptionZh: 和你的守护者同伴传送至和风广场，一起对抗终端过载的电网碎裂乱象！

activities.name: Darkness's Doorstep
activities.description: Track Variks's distress signal.
activities.descriptionZh: 追踪瓦里克斯的求救信号。

activities.nameZh: 传说抗战战场：欧洲无人区
activities.description: Coordinate your fireteam to take on this Legendary challenge. Rescue captives from Shadow Legion prisons across the system.
activities.descriptionZh: 协调你的火力战队，迎接此传说挑战。从位于星系各处的暗影军团监狱中营救俘虏。

activities.name: The Glassway: Customize
activities.description: Eramis activated the Vex portal once built by Clovis Bray. The Exo Stranger asks for your help in stopping the Vex incursion to Europa.
activities.descriptionZh: 伊拉莫斯激活了克洛维斯·布瑞以前建造的Vex传送门。Exo陌客请你帮忙阻止Vex入侵木卫二。

activities.name: Competitive
activities.description: Matches in this playlist affect your Competitive Division placement. Wins will lead to Promotions, increasing your Division placement. Losses will lead to Relegations, lowering your Division placement.
activities.descriptionZh: 此游戏列表中的比赛将影响你的多人竞技级别排名。获胜将成功晋级，提升你的级别排名。落败将导致降级，降低你的级别排名。

activities.name: Shard of the Traveler
activities.description: Return to the Shard of the Traveler and restore your connection to the Light.
activities.descriptionZh: 回到旅行者碎片并恢复你与光能之间的连接。

activities.name: Exodus Crash
activities.description: Purge the Vex and Fallen, who have overrun the Exodus Black crash site.
activities.descriptionZh: 清除占领黑色移民号坠毁现场的Vex和堕落者。

activities.name: Skywatch
activities.description: Missions curated for fireteams of one.
activities.descriptionZh: 为单人火力战队特选的任务。

activities.name: European Aerial Zone: [Arc] Day
activities.description:
Arc energies crackle through the EAZ, filling the air with the smell of ozone.

Equip your Arc subclass and weapons to generate Arc orbs, then collect them to become Arc Empowered. While empowered, Guardians move with enhanced speed, deal greater melee and Sword damage, and drain Super energy half as quickly.
activities.descriptionZh:
电弧能量在欧洲空中区劈啪作响，让空气中充满臭氧的味道。

装备电弧分支职业和武器以生成电弧光球，然后收集这些光球获得电弧强化。守护者进入电弧强化状态时，移动速度会加快、近战和刀剑可造成更大伤害，并且超能能量消耗速度减半。

activities.name: Firewalled Haunted Forest
activities.nameZh: 被防火墙保护的鬼蜮森林
activities.description:
A darkened instance of the Infinite Forest. Descend into its depths and see how far you can get before it disintegrates.

The Firewalled Haunted Forest has no matchmaking.
activities.descriptionZh:
无尽森林的黑暗副本。深入其中，看看在它解体之前你能走多远。

被防火墙保护的鬼蜮森林无法使用匹配。

activities.name: Partition: Hard Reset
activities.description: Chase down a Shadow Legionary wreaking havoc in the VexNet.
activities.descriptionZh: 追捕在Vex网络里猖狂肆虐的一名暗影军团士兵。

activities.name: Kell's Fall: Distortion

activities.descriptionZh: 一路杀入骸骨之环深处，在死亡之歌的咏叹调中幸存下来，然后消灭死亡歌者伊尔·艾拉姆。随后，将她的头骨带给埃里斯·摩恩。

activities.name: Osiris
activities.description: Former Lightbearer
activities.descriptionZh: 前负光者

activities.name: Midtown
activities.description: The Last City, Earth
activities.descriptionZh: 地球，最后的城市

activities.name: Derealize: Customize
activities.description: Investigate the source of a mysterious Taken power—and claim it before anyone else can.
activities.descriptionZh: 调查一股神秘傀儡之力的源头——并抢在他人之前获取它。

activities.name: Heliostat: Customize
activities.description: Infiltrate a forgotten Golden Age facility to prevent the Conductor from launching a dangerously modified Warsat.
activities.descriptionZh: 潜入一处被遗忘的黄金时代设施，阻止指挥者发射经过危险改造的战争卫星。

activities.name: Exploring the Corridors of Time
activities.description: You've saved Saint-14, but you've left the Corridors of Time largely unexplored. See what you can find.
activities.descriptionZh: 你拯救了圣人14号，但时间走廊的大部分地方仍未探索。看看你能有何发现。

activities.name: HyperNet Current
activities.description: Stop the Shadow Legion from bringing down Neomuna's defenses.
activities.descriptionZh: 阻止暗影军团摧毁内欧姆那的防御系统。

activities.name: The Warrior: Matchmade
activities.description: Defeat Eramis's military commander, Phylaks, the Warrior.
activities.descriptionZh: 击败伊拉莫斯的军事指挥官菲拉克斯。

activities.name: Battleground: Conduit
activities.description: Follow the flow of Vex radiolaria deep within Nessus.
activities.descriptionZh: 跟随涅索斯深处的Vex活性放射体液的流动。

activities.name: K1 Crew Quarters (Legendary)
activities.description:
Head to K1 Crew Quarters and defeat the Nightmare of Reyiks, Actuator to retrieve Warmind Bits.

Match Game: Fallen

Champions: Barrier, Overload
activities.descriptionZh:
前往K1员工宿舍并消灭雷伊克斯，激励者的梦魇，回收战争思维币。

元素匹配：堕落者

勇士：屏障，过载

activities.name: The Man Out Of Time
activities.description:
Investigate the time scars on Kepler's surface. Lodi thinks—Lodi hopes—that he might be able to go home.

Missed side quests imprint into Kepler's dark matter. They can be experienced later by stepping through a distorted fourth-dimensional perspective.
activities.descriptionZh:
调查开普勒地表的时间裂痕。洛迪认为——或者说期盼——这或许能带他回家。

错过的支线任务会印入开普勒的暗物质。你可以稍后通过扭曲的四维视角来体验它们。

activities.name: Battleground: Delve: Matchmade
activities.description: Descend into Nessus and explore the Vex structures within.
activities.descriptionZh: 深入涅索斯，探索位于其中的Vex建筑。

activities.name: Guardian Games: Training Playlist: Training—Matchmade
activities.nameZh: 守护者游戏：训练游戏列表: 训练 - 匹配
activities.description: Birthplace of the Vile
activities.descriptionZh: 邪恶温床

activities.name: Supply and Demand
activities.description: An old friend is looking for Red Legion supplies to… reappropriate. Scour Fallen territory for anything to scavenge.
activities.descriptionZh: 一个老朋友正在寻找猩红军团的补给，希望能够……重新占有。在堕落者领地寻找一切能够搜刮的东西。

activities.name: The Up and Up (Heroic)
activities.description: Prevent the Vex from completing a simulation of Fallen combat tactics.
activities.descriptionZh: 阻止Vex完成一次堕落者作战战术模拟。

activities.name: Guardian Games Strikes: Hunters
activities.nameZh: 守护者游戏打击任务：猎人
activities.description: Hunters band together to take on Vanguard strikes.
activities.descriptionZh: 猎人组队参与先锋打击。

activities.name: Off-World Recovery
activities.description: You need something to draw out Xol. A fragment of the Traveler has been located in the EDZ. Recover it.
activities.descriptionZh: 你需要找些什么将尸飕吸引出来。欧洲无人区中有一块旅行者碎块。把它拿回来。

activities.name: Hellas Fortitude, Mars: Smuggle: Private
activities.nameZh: 火星，赫拉斯坚垒：走私: 私人
activities.description: Smuggle contraband from Hellas Fortitude, Mars.
activities.descriptionZh: 从火星的赫拉斯坚垒走私违禁品。

activities.name: Shattered Realm: Ruins of Wrath: Normal
activities.nameZh: 碎裂领域：暴怒废墟: 普通
activities.description:
Traverse the Shattered Realms of the Ascendant Plane in search of the lost Awoken Techeuns.

Matchmaking: OFF
activities.descriptionZh:
在上维位面的碎裂领域中搜寻迷失的觉醒者灵巫。

匹配：关闭

activities.name: Guardian Games: Recreational Playlist: Standard Matchmaking
activities.nameZh: 守护者游戏：休闲游戏列表: 标准匹配
activities.description: Earn Medallions and Vanguard Medals as you compete for individual distinction and class supremacy.
activities.descriptionZh: 赢得勋章和先锋勋章，为个人荣誉和职业霸权而战。

activities.name: Vostok
activities.description: Felwinter Peak, Earth
activities.descriptionZh: 邪冬之巅，地球

activities.name: Deep Storage
activities.description: Search the Pyramidion on Io for a map of the Infinite Forest to guide you to Panoptes.
activities.descriptionZh: 搜索木卫一上的金字塔，搜寻指引你找到潘诺普忒斯的无尽森林地图。

activities.name: Empire Hunt: The Warrior
activities.description: Defeat Eramis's military commander, Phylaks, the Warrior.
activities.descriptionZh: 击败伊拉莫斯的军事指挥官菲拉克斯。

activities.name: My Captain
activities.description: Complete mission "My Captain" on Nessus.
activities.descriptionZh: 在涅索斯上完成任务“我的船长”。

activities.name: Vostok
activities.description: Defend Vanguard forces with the Advanced Defensive Unit against an onslaught of 10 combatant waves.
activities.descriptionZh: 使用高级防御单元保护先锋部队，抵抗10波战斗人员的猛攻。

activities.name: Bannerfall
activities.description: The Last City, Earth
activities.descriptionZh: 地球，最后的城市

activities.name: Unidentified Frame: The Pyramidion
activities.nameZh: 不明确的模型: 金字塔
activities.description: Complete the strike "The Pyramidion" to collect Radiant Phaseglass for the Unidentified Frame.
activities.descriptionZh: 完成打击“金字塔”以为不明确的模型收集辐射相位琉璃。

activities.name: Invasion
activities.description:
Hunt down other Guardians on the Lawless Frontier.

You can wager more Deathmarks from your Wallet to increase your rewards upon success.
activities.descriptionZh:
在无序边界追猎其他守护者。

你可以从你的钱包追加更多死亡标记作为赌注，来提升成功时的奖励。

activities.name: Fragment
activities.description: Unknown, The Infinite Forest
activities.descriptionZh: 未知，无尽森林

activities.name: Bergusia Forge
activities.description: Bring any Black Armory weapon frame or research frame to the Bergusia Forge to be crafted.
activities.descriptionZh: 将任意黑色军械库武器模型或研究模型放入柏尔古希亚锻炉，并将它们制造出来。

activities.name: Heist Battleground: Europa
activities.description: Brave the cold winds of Europa to reclaim fragments of a hidden submind's code from the depths of Bray Exoscience.
activities.descriptionZh: 勇闯木卫二的寒风，从布瑞Exo科学所深处取回隐匿子思维的代码碎片。

activities.name: Midtown
activities.description: The Last City, Earth
activities.descriptionZh: 地球，最后的城市

activities.name: Proving Grounds: Customize
activities.description: Defeat Caiatl's Chosen aboard the Land Tank, Halphas Electus, on Nessus.
activities.descriptionZh: 在涅索斯的陆地坦克哈帕斯·伊莱克特斯上击败查厄托的天选者。

activities.name: Heist Battleground: Moon
activities.description: Infiltrate the Seraph bunker tucked under the dust of the Moon to reclaim fragments of the submind Malahayati's code.
activities.descriptionZh: 潜入藏在月尘之下的炽天使地堡，取回子思维玛拉哈雅提的代码碎片。

activities.name: Team Scorched: Matchmade
activities.description: Everyone on both teams has a Scorch Cannon. Be brave.
activities.descriptionZh: 双方所有人都持有灼烧发射器。勇往直前。

activities.name: Invasion: Selina Morass, Venus: Sabotage
activities.nameZh: 入侵: 金星，塞琳娜沼泽：破坏
activities.description: Selina Morass, Venus: Sabotage
activities.descriptionZh: 金星，塞琳娜沼泽：破坏

activities.name: Vow of the Disciple: Standard
activities.description: The disciple beckons…
activities.descriptionZh: 门徒发出召唤…

activities.name: Nightfall Grandmaster: The Arms Dealer
activities.nameZh: 宗师日落: 军火交易商
activities.description: The Arms Dealer
activities.descriptionZh: 军火交易商

activities.name: The Reckoning: Tier III
activities.description: Venture into the mysterious Haul that the Drifter tows behind his ship to reckon with greater powers.
activities.descriptionZh: 进入浪客飞船后面拖着的神秘曳室，算算自己能否获得更高的能量。

activities.name: Cutting Edge: Oddball: Matchmade
activities.nameZh: 尖端装备：怪球: 匹配
activities.description:
Cutting Edge: Only New Gear permitted. New Gear also grants reward bonuses.

Achieve victory by earning relics. Score points by using the relics to defeat opponents.
activities.descriptionZh:
尖端装备：只允许使用新装备，且新装备提供奖励加成。

获取圣物以获得胜利。使用圣物击败对手来获得分数。

activities.name: Nightmare Hunt: Despair
activities.description: Defeat the Nightmare of Crota, Son of Oryx.
activities.descriptionZh: 消灭欧里克斯之子，克洛塔之梦魇

activities.name: Widow's Court
activities.description: European Dead Zone, Earth
activities.descriptionZh: 欧洲无人区，地球

activities.name: Emperor's Respite
activities.description: Prison Barge, Leviathan
activities.descriptionZh: 监狱驳船，利维坦

activities.name: Deep Dives: Deep Dives (Matchmade)
activities.nameZh: 深渊潜水: 深渊潜水（匹配）
activities.description:
Dive into the dark waters of Titan's methane sea and battle sunken horrors to retrieve precious resources for Sloane's newfound ally, Ahsa.

Victory at each depth leads ever deeper to greater rewards, hidden treasures, and challenges beneath Kraken Mare.
activities.descriptionZh:
潜入土卫六黑暗的甲烷海，与出没海底的恐怖生物作战，为斯隆的新盟友阿莎取回珍贵资源。

在每个深度层取得胜利，下潜越深，奖励就越多。隐藏的宝藏和挑战都在克拉肯海中等着你。

activities.name: Haunted Forest
activities.description: A darkened instance of the Infinite Forest. Descend into its depths with a fireteam, and see how far you can get before it disintegrates.
activities.descriptionZh: 无尽森林的黑暗副本。带领一支火力战队深入其中，看看在它解体之前你们能走多远。

activities.name: Showdown
activities.description:
"This combat drill will test you from start to finish. Stay on your game, lest you find yourself on the wrong end of the final showdown." —Lord Shaxx

Fight for Valor by defeating opponents and preventing revives. Win the most rounds or face off in an elimination showdown.
activities.descriptionZh:
“这次战斗演习将从头到尾地对你进行检验。小心别死了，不然你就有可能出现在失败的那一方了。”——领主沙克斯

击败对手并阻止敌人复活，为英勇而战。争取赢得最多回合，或在最终决战中取胜。

activities.name: Fabled Mission: Quarantine
activities.description: Destroy a powerful Vex Mind to breach the quarantine around the singularity, and seize the final strangelet capsule.
activities.descriptionZh: 摧毁强大的Vex思维以突破奇点周围的隔离，夺取最后的奇异子胶囊。

activities.name: Mythic Mission: Quarantine
activities.description: One last big push to the far side of the Vex Quarantine Zone to uncover and defeat their containment projector.
activities.descriptionZh: 发起最后一次大规模推进，深入Vex隔离区的远端，找到并击败它们的遏制投射器。

activities.name: Wormhaven
activities.description: New Pacific Arcology, Titan
activities.descriptionZh: 土卫六，新太平洋生态园区

activities.name: The Citadel
activities.description: The Dreaming City
activities.descriptionZh: 幽梦之城

activities.name: Guardian Games: Competitive Nightfall: Advanced
activities.nameZh: 守护者游戏：多人竞技日落: 高级
activities.description: Heist Battleground: Mars
activities.descriptionZh: 盗劫战场：火星

activities.name: Totality Division Territory
activities.description:
No Bonus Active

Complete a Priority Contract in a Contested Territory to earn its Fortified Territory bonus the following day.
activities.descriptionZh:
暂无生效加成

在必争之地完成一份首要合约，即可于次日获得其强化地盘加成。

activities.name: The Ghosts: Normal
activities.description: Follow Fynch's tip to a Hive temple that may contain a clue about how Savathûn stole the Light.
activities.descriptionZh: 跟着芬奇的情报前往一座邪魔族寺庙。那里面可能有关于萨瓦图恩窃取光能的方法的线索。

activities.name: Nightfall: The Hollowed Lair
activities.description: The Fanatic has returned. Take him down and finish the job you started.
activities.descriptionZh: 狂热者回来了。消灭他，完成由你开始的工作。

activities.name: Unsafe at Any Speed
activities.description: A nasty Fallen Pike gang is wreaking havoc in the area. Capture enemy vehicles and use them to even the odds.
activities.descriptionZh: 一队讨厌的堕落者派克正在该区域内肆虐。夺取敌人的载具并利用它们扳回劣势。

activities.name: Disjunction
activities.description: Runoff, Savathûn's Throne World
activities.descriptionZh: 决赛，萨瓦图恩的王座世界

activities.name: Exodus Crash
activities.description: Purge the Vex and Fallen, who have overrun the Exodus Black crash site.
activities.descriptionZh: 清除占领黑色移民号坠毁现场的Vex和堕落者。

activities.name: Battleground: Behemoth
activities.description: Empress Caiatl has deployed a tank fortress to Nessus and opened an invitation to survivors of the Red Legion to vie for a seat on her War Council. Vanquish the Cabal and prove yourself in glorious combat against her Chosen.
activities.descriptionZh: 查厄托女王在涅索斯部署了一座坦克要塞，并邀请猩红军团的幸存者前往争夺她的战争议会席位。消灭卡巴尔，在对抗她的天选者的荣耀之战中证明你自己。

activities.name: Heist Battleground: Europa
activities.description: Brave the cold winds of Europa to reclaim fragments of a hidden submind's code from the depths of Bray Exoscience.
activities.descriptionZh: 勇闯木卫二的寒风，从布瑞Exo科学所深处取回隐匿子思维的代码碎片。

activities.name: Nightfall Grandmaster: Warden of Nothing
activities.nameZh: 宗师日落: 虚无典狱官
activities.description: Warden of Nothing
activities.descriptionZh: 虚无典狱官

activities.name: Pirate Hideout: The Scrapworker
activities.description: Storm Ithyks, the Scrapworker's Hideout and claim a lost relic.
activities.descriptionZh: 猛攻废料工伊瑟克斯的藏身处并拿到一件失落的圣物。

activities.name: Iconoclasm: Cooperative Focus Campaign
activities.nameZh: 破除圣像: 合作专注战役
activities.description: Using the Vanguard's diversion and your fireteam's resourcefulness, seek out the ritual site where the Witness was created to learn how to destroy it.
activities.descriptionZh: 利用先锋的声东击西和你火力战队的智慧谋略，找到见证者被造的仪式地点，了解如何摧毁它。

activities.name: Rush Remixed: Matchmade
activities.description:
Smash your way through a randomized selection of 5 iconic encounters before the timer expires. Blast combatants with additional ammo:

- Encounter 1: Rally Banner
- Encounter 4: Heavy Ammo
activities.descriptionZh:
在时间结束前，在5场随机经典遭遇战中一路过关斩将。用额外弹药轰飞战斗人员：

- 遭遇战1：集结旗帜
- 遭遇战4：重型弹药

activities.name: The Hollowed Lair
activities.description: The Fanatic has returned. Take him down and finish the job you started.
activities.descriptionZh: 狂热者回来了。消灭他，完成由你开始的工作。

activities.name: The Hollowed Lair
activities.description: The Fanatic has returned. Take him down and finish the job you started.
activities.descriptionZh: 狂热者回来了。消灭他，完成由你开始的工作。

activities.name: The Hollowed Lair
activities.description: The Fanatic has returned. Take him down and finish the job you started.
activities.descriptionZh: 狂热者回来了。消灭他，完成由你开始的工作。

activities.name: Target: The Rifleman
activities.description: Avenge Cayde's death by crossing the Scorned Baron known as the Rifleman off your list.
activities.descriptionZh: 从你的报仇名单上划去名为枪客的嗤魅公爵，为凯德的死报仇。

activities.name: Tharsis Outpost
activities.description: Scoundrels wheel, deal, clash, and carouse on the lawless sands of Mars.
activities.descriptionZh: 恶棍们在火星的无序沙地中纵横捭阖、械斗狂欢。

activities.name: Elimination
activities.description:
"This is the ultimate test of your skill as a fireteam, Guardians! Make me proud." —Lord Shaxx

Fight for Valor by eliminating all opponents in this round-based mode.
activities.descriptionZh:
“守护者，这是对你作为火力战队技能的终极测试！别让我失望。”—领主沙克斯

为英勇而战，在这个回合制的模式中消灭所有对手。

activities.name: Widow's Court: Customize
activities.description: Defend the Advanced Defensive Unit against an onslaught of 30 combatant waves.
activities.descriptionZh: 保护高级防御单元，抵抗30波战斗人员的猛攻。

activities.name: Gambit Labs
activities.description:
Compete in an experimental version of Gambit.

Mote Thief: Invaders can steal Motes by standing near the bank!
activities.descriptionZh:
参加一场实验版本的智谋模式比赛。

萤光怪盗：入侵者可以站在萤光库附近窃取萤光！

activities.name: Private Match
activities.description: Create a custom PvP match with your fireteam, and best your comrades for personal glory… and bragging rights.
activities.descriptionZh: 创建自定义PVP比赛，与火力战队和好友一起，为荣誉……和炫耀的资本而战。

activities.name: Freelance Glory: Survival
activities.description: Fight for Glory Rank points by depleting your opponents' shared life pool and then eliminating them.
activities.descriptionZh: 削减对手的共享生命池，然后消灭他们，为荣耀等级点数而战。

activities.name: Convergence
activities.description: Infinite Forest, Mercury
activities.descriptionZh: 水星，无尽森林

activities.name: The Last Chance: Legendary
activities.description: Infiltrate Savathûn's fortress to recover an artifact linked to her acquisition of the Light.
activities.descriptionZh: 潜入萨瓦图恩的要塞，取回与她获得光能有关的一件神器。

activities.name: Forge Ignition
activities.description: Complete a forge ignition at the Gofannon Forge
activities.descriptionZh: 完成一次戈菲隆锻炉的锻炉炼燃

activities.name: Vault of Glass: Challenge Mode
activities.description: All Encounter Challenges Enabled and Required
activities.descriptionZh: 所有关卡挑战开启且为必需

activities.name: Convergence
activities.description: Infinite Forest, Mercury
activities.descriptionZh: 水星，无尽森林

activities.name: Turophile
activities.description:
Something is different about the Vex on Kepler. Some have turned on each other. Learn why, and disrupt their plans.

Missed side quests imprint into Kepler's dark matter. They can be experienced later by stepping through a distorted fourth-dimensional perspective.
activities.descriptionZh:
开普勒上的Vex与其他地方不同，有些会互相攻击。查明原因，并破坏它们的计划。

错过的支线任务会印入开普勒的暗物质。你可以稍后通过扭曲的四维视角来体验它们。

activities.name: Heart's Desire
activities.description: Speak with Queen Mara Sov in the Confluence, within the Dreaming City.
activities.descriptionZh: 前往幽梦之城的汇流与玛拉·索维女王交谈。

activities.name: Endless Vale
activities.description: Arcadian Valley, Nessus
activities.descriptionZh: 涅索斯，阿卡狄亚谷

activities.name: Looped
activities.description: No one's heard from Cayde-6 since the Hunter took off for an uncharted world. Track him down.
activities.descriptionZh: 在凯德6号前往了一个未知世界后，就没人再听过这位猎人的消息了。追随他的踪迹。

activities.name: Exodus Siege
activities.description: The Fallen prepare to attack Failsafe's mainframe aboard the Exodus Black.
activities.descriptionZh: 堕落者准备攻击黑色移民号上智能失效保险的主机。

activities.name: Warden of Nothing
activities.description: Help the Drifter restore order at the Prison of Elders.
activities.descriptionZh: 帮助浪客复原长老监狱的秩序。

activities.name: Rushdown
activities.description: Smash your way through a curated selection of iconic encounters before the timer expires.
activities.descriptionZh: 在时间结束前，在一系列经典遭遇战中一路过关斩将。

activities.descriptionZh: 在诺克里斯完成仪式前将其击败。

activities.name: The Warrior: Master
activities.description: Defeat Eramis's military commander, Phylaks, the Warrior.
activities.descriptionZh: 击败伊拉莫斯的军事指挥官菲拉克斯。

activities.name: The Warrior: Expert
activities.description: Defeat Eramis's military commander, Phylaks, the Warrior.
activities.descriptionZh: 击败伊拉莫斯的军事指挥官菲拉克斯。

activities.description: Defeat Eramis's military commander, Phylaks, the Warrior.
activities.descriptionZh: 击败伊拉莫斯的军事指挥官菲拉克斯。

activities.name: Heist Battleground: Mars
activities.description: Blitz the BrayTech Futurescape campus on Mars to repossess fragments of the submind Charlemagne's code.
activities.descriptionZh: 闪击火星上的布瑞科技未来景象园区，收回子思维查理曼大帝的代码碎片。

activities.name: Empire Hunt: The Dark Priestess
activities.description: Defeat the new leader of the Fallen, Kridis, the Dark Priestess.
activities.descriptionZh: 击败堕落者的新领袖，克里迪斯，暗影女祭司。

activities.name: Nessus, Unstable Centaur
activities.nameZh: 不稳定半人马座，涅索斯
activities.description: A planetoid with an irregular orbit, converted by the Vex for purposes unknown.
activities.descriptionZh: 拥有不规则轨道的小行星，被Vex转化，原因未知。

activities.name: Advent
activities.description: Welcome to the Tower: the last bastion of humanity against the forces of Darkness.
activities.descriptionZh: 欢迎来到高塔：人类抗击暗影势力的最后堡垒。

activities.name: Vex Offensive
activities.description: Enter a portal to the Black Garden and fight on the frontlines of an ongoing battle against the Vex.
activities.descriptionZh: 进入通往黑暗花园的传送门，到与Vex的战斗前线参与战斗。

activities.name: Dark Alliance
activities.description: Red Legion Psions are meddling with forces best left alone. Investigate their connection to dark forces in the region.
activities.descriptionZh: 猩红军团辅助士兵正在干预最好不要接触的势力。调查他们与区域中黑暗力量的联系。

activities.name: Leviathan, Spire of Stars
activities.description: On the wings of Icarus.
activities.descriptionZh: 凌驾于伊卡洛斯之翼。

activities.name: Battleground: Delve
activities.description: Descend into Nessus and explore the Vex structures within.
activities.descriptionZh: 深入涅索斯，探索位于其中的Vex建筑。

activities.name: : Zone Control
activities.description:
"There will come a day when the Tower falls again. Our ability to hold territory is paramount." —Lord Saladin

Capture zones to increase points for each opponent defeated. Capture all three to lock the zones and hunt your opponents.
activities.descriptionZh:
“终会有高塔再次倾倒的那天。我们守护领土的能力至关重要。”——领主萨拉丁

占领区域可提升每个击败的对手所提供的分数。占领全部三个区域可锁定并猎杀你的对手。

activities.name: Daily Heroic Story Mission: Pilgrimage
activities.nameZh: 日常英雄剧情任务: 朝圣之旅
activities.description: Complete the Daily Heroic story mission.
activities.descriptionZh: 完成日常英雄剧情任务。

activities.name: Breakthrough
activities.description:
"Deploying the Breaker makes a wager with your opponents. Don't let them call your bluff." —Lord Shaxx

Fight for Valor by deploying the Breaker and hacking the opposing vault or by defending your own vault.
activities.descriptionZh:
“部署断路器来跟你的对手赌一把。不能让他们认为你在虚张声势。”——领主沙克斯

部署断路器并入侵对手的保险库或防守你自己的保险库，为英勇而战。

activities.name: Duality: Master
activities.description: Dive into the depths of the exiled emperor's mind in search of dark secrets.
activities.descriptionZh: 深入流放大帝的心灵深处，搜寻黑暗秘密。

activities.name: The Runner
activities.description: Stop a Cabal simulation carrying heavily encrypted data.
activities.descriptionZh: 阻止一次带有高度加密数据的卡巴尔模拟。

activities.name: Nightfall Grandmaster
activities.description: Grandmaster
activities.descriptionZh: 宗师

activities.name: Typhon Imperator
activities.description: Return to Neomuna to stop the nefarious machinations of the Dread and Shadow Legion.
activities.descriptionZh: 返回内欧姆那，阻止恐惧和暗影军团的邪恶阴谋。

activities.name: Cauldron
activities.description: Ocean of Storms, Moon
activities.descriptionZh: 风暴海洋，月球

activities.name: (Heroic) Bad Neighbors
activities.description: Resolve a dangerous conflict between the Fallen and the Hive.
activities.descriptionZh: 解决堕落者和邪魔族力量之间的危险冲突。

activities.name: Defiant Battlegrounds
activities.description: Launch daring rescue missions to liberate civilian captives from Shadow Legion prisons.
activities.descriptionZh: 启动大胆营救任务，从暗影军团监狱中营救平民俘虏。

activities.name: Vault of Glass: Master
activities.description: Beneath Venus, evil stirs…
activities.descriptionZh: 金星之下，暗流涌动…

activities.name: Multiplex
activities.description: Vex Network Compiler, Mars
activities.descriptionZh: Vex网络编译器，火星

activities.name: Fearsome Retainer: Legendary
activities.description: Spider has brokered a deal. Meet the Pikers on the crime boss's barge and secure the Splicer Shank.
activities.descriptionZh: 蛛王促成了一项交易。在这名犯罪首领的驳船上会见派克组，获得熔岩军团侦察机。

activities.name: The Paper Crane
activities.description:
Garner a better unstanding of how dark matter is woven through Kepler and its inhabitants.

Missed side quests imprint into Kepler's dark matter. They can be experienced later, by stepping through a distorted fourth-dimensional perspective.
activities.descriptionZh:
深入了解暗物质如何渗透开普勒及其居民。

错过的支线任务会印入开普勒的暗物质。你可以稍后通过扭曲的四维视角来体验它们。

activities.name: Private Match Limited
activities.description: REWARDS ENABLED! Create a custom PvP match with your fireteam, and best your comrades for personal glory… and bragging rights.
activities.descriptionZh: 奖励已启用！创建自定义PvP比赛，与火力战队和好友一起，为荣誉…和炫耀的资本而战。

activities.name: (Heroic) Siren Song
activities.description: Disrupt a Hive Ritual to keep the Rig from sinking.
activities.descriptionZh: 干扰邪魔族力量仪式，防止钻井下沉。

activities.name: Nightfall: The Corrupted
activities.description: Hunt down one of Queen Mara's most trusted advisors and free her from Taken possession.
activities.descriptionZh: 找到玛拉女王最信任的顾问之一，帮助她摆脱傀儡军团的支配。

activities.name: The Sieve
activities.description: Drifter is preparing the Haul. Make ready to protect his operation and collect dark matter from Kepler's mysterious anomaly.
activities.descriptionZh: 浪客正在准备曳室。做好准备以守护他的行动，从开普勒神秘的异常点中收集暗物质。

activities.name: (Heroic) Hack the Planet
activities.description: Ghost has a plan to interface with the Nessus core. But he'll need Failsafe's help.
activities.descriptionZh: 机灵计划与涅索斯核心连接。但他需要智能失效保险的协助。

activities.name: The Glassway
activities.description: Eramis activated the Vex portal once built by Clovis Bray. The Exo Stranger asks for your help in stopping the Vex incursion to Europa.
activities.descriptionZh: 伊拉莫斯激活了克洛维斯·布瑞以前建造的Vex传送门。Exo陌客请你帮忙阻止Vex入侵木卫二。

activities.name: Battleground: Foothold: Matchmade
activities.description: In an act of vengeance for the destruction of their homeworld, the Cabal have struck out against a Hive nest dug deep into the Cosmodrome. Use this opportunity to hit the Cabal hard and show them that humanity will not back down.
activities.descriptionZh: 为了报复对自身母星的毁灭，卡巴尔袭击了位于发射基地地下深处的一处邪魔族巢穴。利用这个机会给予卡巴尔沉重打击，告诉他们人类是不会退缩的。

activities.name: Private Match Limited
activities.description: REWARDS ENABLED! Create a custom PvP match with your fireteam, and best your comrades for personal glory… and bragging rights.
activities.descriptionZh: 奖励已启用！创建自定义PvP比赛，与火力战队和好友一起，为荣誉…和炫耀的资本而战。

activities.name: Nightfall: The Inverted Spire: Prestige
activities.nameZh: 日落：倒置尖塔: 巅峰
activities.description: End the Red Legion expedition that has ripped open the planet's surface.
activities.descriptionZh: 结束撕裂行星地表的猩红军团远征行动。

activities.name: Empire Hunt: The Dark Priestess
activities.description: Defeat the new leader of the Fallen, Kridis, the Dark Priestess.
activities.descriptionZh: 击败堕落者的新领袖，克里迪斯，暗影女祭司。

activities.name: Oblation: Soulfed: Customize
activities.description: The second part of Exotic mission "Oblation." Delve into the Hive's soulfire reservoir, sabotage their biomechanisms, and close in on the heart of the forge.
activities.descriptionZh: 异域任务“奉献”的第二部分。深入邪魔族的魂火蓄库，破坏它们的生物机械结构，逼近锻炉核心。

activities.name: The Scarlet Keep
activities.description: Investigate the recently erected Scarlet Keep and discover its dark purpose.
activities.descriptionZh: 调查新近出现的猩红要塞，查明它的黑暗目的。

activities.name: Last City: Eliksni Quarter
activities.description: The area of the Last City that shelters Mithrax and his House of Light.
activities.descriptionZh: 圣城内用来庇护米瑟拉克斯及其光能氏族的区域。

activities.name: The Conflux: Customize
activities.description: Drive out enemies trying to anchor themselves on Nessus.
activities.descriptionZh: 驱逐试图在涅索斯立足的敌人。

activities.name: Guardian Games: Competitive Nightfall: Advanced
activities.nameZh: 守护者游戏：多人竞技日落: 高级
activities.description: The Corrupted
activities.descriptionZh: 腐化

activities.name: Battleground: Oracle
activities.description: A group of former Red Legion Psions are communing with Vex prediction engines deep within Nessus. They seek to gain tactical insights by analyzing simulations of future events against their own psychic foresight.  Eliminate this threat before they can deliver their intelligence to Empress Caiatl.
activities.descriptionZh: 一群原属猩红军团的灵能士兵在涅索斯深处与Vex预言引擎进行交流。他们想通过分析针对他们自身灵能预感的未来事件模拟来取得战术优势。在他们将情报传回给查厄托女王之前，消灭这个威胁。

activities.name: Proving Grounds: Customize
activities.description: Defeat Caiatl's Chosen aboard the Land Tank, Halphas Electus, on Nessus.
activities.descriptionZh: 在涅索斯的陆地坦克哈帕斯·伊莱克特斯上击败查厄托的天选者。

activities.name: Survival
activities.description: Fight for Glory in more focused combat scenarios.
activities.descriptionZh: 在一个战斗更集中的场景中为荣耀而战。

activities.name: Faculty Advisement
activities.description:
Humanity has another outpost here. Despite their differences, they came from the same Earth, long ago. Learn from the Aionians, and find those common roots.

Missed side quests imprint into Kepler's dark matter. They can be experienced later, by stepping through a distorted fourth-dimensional perspective.
activities.descriptionZh:
人类在此处有另一个前哨站。尽管存在差异，但他们很久以前来自同一个地球。向艾昂人学习，探寻共同的根源。

错过的支线任务会印入开普勒的暗物质。你可以稍后通过扭曲的四维视角来体验它们。

activities.name: Captive Memories
activities.description: Locate Fikrul in the Tomb of Elders before he can bring his plans to fruition.
activities.descriptionZh: 在费克鲁实现其计划之前，在长老之墓中找到他。

activities.name: Eternity
activities.description: Unknown Space
activities.descriptionZh: 未知空间

activities.name: Lost Hope
activities.description: Find a scenic spot in the Exodus Black on Nessus.
activities.descriptionZh: 在涅索斯的黑色移民号内找到一处景色优美的地方。

activities.name: The Hangman (Heroic)
activities.description: Avenge Cayde's death by crossing the Scorned Baron known as the Hangman off your list.
activities.descriptionZh: 从你的报仇名单上划去名为刽子手的嗤魅公爵，为凯德的死报仇。

activities.name: Expunge: Corrupted Tartarus
activities.description: The Taken have infested what remains of the Tartarus domain within the Vex Nexus and wrested control of the Oppressive Mind. Return and destroy the Oppressive Mind once and for all.
activities.descriptionZh: 傀儡军团感染了Vex纳克斯枢纽的塔耳塔罗斯领域残余，并控制了暴虐首脑。返回那里彻底摧毁暴虐首脑。

activities.name: Private Match
activities.description: Create a custom PvP match with your fireteam, and best your comrades for personal glory… and bragging rights.
activities.descriptionZh: 创建自定义PVP比赛，与火力战队和好友一起，为荣誉……和炫耀的资本而战。

activities.name: Nightmare Hunt: Insanity
activities.description: Defeat the Nightmare of the Fanatic.
activities.descriptionZh: 消灭狂热者之梦魇。

activities.name: Destiny 2: Beyond Light
activities.description: Continue the Beyond Light campaign and unlock the power of Stasis.
activities.descriptionZh: 继续《凌光之刻》战役并解锁冰影的力量。

activities.name: Veil Containment
activities.description: An Ishtar Collective research facility housing the dangerous paracausal enigma known as "the Veil."
activities.descriptionZh: 一处伊什塔集团研究设施，里面存放着被称为“面纱”的危险超因果谜团。

activities.name: Showdown: Matchmade
activities.description: Achieve victory by defeating opponents and preventing revives. Win the most rounds or face off in an elimination showdown.
activities.descriptionZh: 击败对手并阻止敌人复活，以获得胜利。争取赢得最多回合，或在最终决战中取胜。

activities.name: Expedition: Cosmodrome
activities.description: Dig up buried pirate riches in the Cosmodrome, fight off raiders, and deliver the treasure haul to your Ketch!
activities.descriptionZh: 挖出深埋在发射基地的海盗宝藏，击退突袭者，并将宝藏堆运回你的双桅船！

activities.name: //node.ovrd.AVALON//: Legend
activities.description: Investigate a Vex network node in the EDZ that has been overwritten with a single word: AVALON.
activities.descriptionZh: 调查欧洲无人区中的一个Vex网络节点，该节点已被一个词覆盖：阿瓦隆。

activities.name: A Shadow Overhead
activities.description: Beneath the last place touched by the Traveler.
activities.descriptionZh: 位于被旅行者触碰过的最后地点下方。

activities.descriptionZh: 精华，地球轨道

activities.descriptionZh: 在金星的塞琳娜沼泽追猎一名声名狼藉的不法之徒并获取其悬赏。

activities.descriptionZh: 从金星的塞琳娜沼泽走私违禁品。

activities.descriptionZh: 光明邪魔族用窃取的守护者光能作恶。攻破他们的堡垒，揭露他们的阴谋。

activities.descriptionZh: 通过引爆或拆除两个对方炸弹来取胜。

activities.descriptionZh: 猩红军团攻入最后的城市。光能消失。你无力抵抗。活下去，择日再战。

activities.description: Search the depths of Savathûn's throne world for a way to unlock the secrets of Sagira's shell.
activities.descriptionZh: 搜索萨瓦图恩王座世界的深处，以找到解开萨吉拉机壳秘密的方法。

activities.name: Encore: Customize
activities.description: Explore the strange structures at the core of Nessus, converted by the Vex at the Conductor's command.
activities.descriptionZh: 探索位于涅索斯核心的奇特建筑，它是Vex奉指挥者之命转化而成的。

activities.name: Lake of Shadows
activities.description: Purge the European Dead Zone of the Taken and Shadow Legion forces threatening to overtake the Reservoir and poison the precious water it holds.
activities.descriptionZh: 在欧洲无人区清除威胁要占领水库并污染其珍贵水源的傀儡军团和暗影军团部队。

activities.name: Rusted Lands
activities.description: Eastern Flood Zone, Earth
activities.descriptionZh: 东方洪水区，地球

activities.name: Last City: Eliksni Quarter
activities.description: The area of the Last City that shelters Mithrax and his House of Light.
activities.descriptionZh: 圣城内用来庇护米瑟拉克斯及其光能氏族的区域。

activities.name: Mission: The Invitation: Legendary
activities.description: Follow Ikora into the Oort Cloud. An invitation has been sent. See what awaits.
activities.descriptionZh: 跟随艾可拉进入奥尔特云。邀请已被发出。拭目以待吧。

activities.name: Supremacy
activities.description: Achieve victory by defeating opponents and securing the crests they drop. Recover friendly crests to deny them from opponents.
activities.descriptionZh: 击败对手并收集他们掉落的纹章，以获得胜利。回收友方纹章可以阻止对手获得它们。

activities.name: Guardian Games: Competitive Nightfall: Advanced
activities.nameZh: 守护者游戏：多人竞技日落: 高级
activities.description: The Inverted Spire
activities.descriptionZh: 倒置尖塔

activities.name: Legion's Folly
activities.description: Arcadian Valley, Nessus
activities.descriptionZh: 涅索斯，阿卡狄亚谷

activities.name: Hellas Fortitude, Mars: Sabotage: Matchmade
activities.nameZh: 火星，赫拉斯坚垒：破坏: 匹配
activities.description: Sabotage hostile assets in Hellas Fortitude, Mars.
activities.descriptionZh: 在火星的赫拉斯坚垒破坏敌方资产。

activities.name: Nightfall: Will of the Thousands: Normal
activities.nameZh: 日落：千之意志: 普通
activities.description: Liberate Rasputin by bringing an end to Xol's infestation of Mars.
activities.descriptionZh: 结束火星尸飕的危害，解放拉斯普廷。

activities.name: Nightmare Hunt: Servitude
activities.description: Defeat the Nightmare of Zydron, Gate Lord.
activities.descriptionZh: 消灭门神磁特轮的梦魇。

activities.name: Crucible Labs
activities.description: Participate in experimental, work-in-progress Crucible experiences. For more information on Crucible Labs, visit bungie.net.
activities.descriptionZh: 快来加入正在进行的实验型熔炉竞技场试验。关于熔炉竞技场实验室的更多信息，请访问bungie.net。

activities.name: Unbreakable
activities.description: Failsafe has caught wind of Vex tech that could result in unstoppable barriers.
activities.descriptionZh: 智能失效保险偶然了解到Vex拥有能够建造坚不可摧屏障的技术。

activities.name: The Reckoning: Tier I
activities.description: Venture into the mysterious Haul that the Drifter tows behind his ship to reckon with greater powers.
activities.descriptionZh: 进入浪客飞船后面拖着的神秘曳室，算算自己能否获得更高的能量。

activities.name: Legendary PsiOps Battleground: Moon
activities.nameZh: 传说灵能行动战场：月球
activities.description: The Lucent Hive have opened a portal between Savathûn's throne world and the Scarlet Keep. Break up the portal ritual, and prevent a full-scale invasion of Earth.
activities.descriptionZh: 光明邪魔族打开了萨瓦图恩王座世界和猩红要塞之间的传送门。阻止传送门仪式，防止他们全面入侵地球。

activities.name: The Silver of the Moon
activities.description: Find a scenic spot in Archer's Line on the Moon.
activities.descriptionZh: 在月球的弓手界线内找到一处景色优美的地方。

activities.name: Nightfall: The Arms Dealer
activities.description: Shut down the operations of an ironmonger providing weapons to the Red Legion.
activities.descriptionZh: 终止向猩红军团提供武器的军械商的行为。

activities.name: Kell's Grave
activities.description: Tangled Shore, The Reef
activities.descriptionZh: 暗礁，纷争海岸

activities.name: Riptide
activities.description: Without power, Zavala's resistance has hit a wall. Travel deeper into the Arcology and help them past it.
activities.descriptionZh: 没有能量，萨瓦拉的反抗军碰了壁。深入生态园区并帮他们通过那里。

activities.name: Trials of Osiris
activities.description:
Eliminate your opponents or capture the zone to win. Earn as many round and match wins on a ticket as you can.

Passages grant reward bonus.
activities.descriptionZh:
消灭对手或占领区域来获胜。充分利用入场券，尽可能多地获得回合及比赛胜利。

入场券可提供奖励加成。

activities.name: Getting Your Hands Dirty
activities.description: Seize upon the Taken invasion of the EDZ, direct their assault against the Red Legion, and end it before it gets out of control.
activities.descriptionZh: 利用傀儡军团对欧洲无人区的入侵，把他们的进攻引向猩红军团，在事态失控前解决此事。

activities.name: A Hum of Starlight
activities.description: Return to the Watchtower, and this time, pass through the door at its top.
activities.descriptionZh: 返回守望塔，这一次穿过塔顶的门。

activities.name: Cabal's Watch
activities.description: Take Earth back from the Conductor's forces! Fight across combat zones in the now SIVA-free Plaguelands, from a ruined tanker to an ancient missile silo. Battle to secure powerful Golden Age salvage before your foes do!
activities.descriptionZh: 从指挥者部队手中夺回地球！如今瘟疫之地已无湿婆，你需要在废弃储罐和古老的导弹发射井等战区进行作战。抢在敌人之前，夺取强大的黄金时代回收物！

activities.name: Defiant Battleground: Orbital Prison
activities.description: Rescue captives from a Shadow Legion prison in near-Earth orbit.
activities.descriptionZh: 从位于近地轨道的暗影军团监狱中营救俘虏。

activities.name: The Dead Cliffs
activities.description: European Dead Zone, Earth
activities.descriptionZh: 地球，欧洲无人区

activities.nameZh: 金星，阿蒂西亚山：破坏: 匹配

activities.descriptionZh: 在金星的阿蒂西亚山破坏敌方资产。

activities.descriptionZh: 地球，欧洲无人区

activities.descriptionZh: 云端行者，宁博思的导师

activities.name: The Lightblade
activities.description: Recover an artifact from a monument to Oryx, located deep in the swamps of Savathûn's throne world.
activities.descriptionZh: 前往位于萨瓦图恩王座世界沼泽深处的欧里克斯纪念碑，取回一件神器。

activities.name: The Citadel
activities.description: The Dreaming City
activities.descriptionZh: 幽梦之城

activities.name: Guardian Games: Competitive Nightfall: Advanced
activities.nameZh: 守护者游戏：多人竞技日落: 高级
activities.description: Legend PsiOps Battleground: Cosmodrome
activities.descriptionZh: 传说灵能行动战场：发射基地

activities.name: In the Deep
activities.description:
Somewhere in the horrific depths of the Hellmouth lies the Hive Cryptoglyph. With it, Eris Morn can craft further Dreambane armor for your quest to find a way inside the Pyramid.

The Cryptoglyph is yours to take from the Hive… if you can.
activities.descriptionZh:
在地狱深渊之下的某处，藏有一块邪魔族秘符。有了它，埃里斯·摩恩就能打造出更多梦境祸根护甲，从而帮助你找到进入金字塔的路。

秘符正等待着你将它从邪魔族的手中夺走……如果你有这个能力的话。

activities.name: Shard of the Traveler
activities.description: Return to the Shard of the Traveler and restore your connection to the Light.
activities.descriptionZh: 回到旅行者碎片并恢复你与光能之间的连接。

activities.name: Convergence
activities.description: Infinite Forest, Mercury
activities.descriptionZh: 水星，无尽森林

activities.name: Nightmare Hunt: Pride
activities.description: Defeat the Nightmare of Skolas, Kell of Kells.
activities.descriptionZh: 消灭凯尔之王斯格拉斯的梦魇

activities.name: Control
activities.description:
"The key to victory is not simply capturing territory, but knowing exactly how and when to push your advantage." —Lord Shaxx

Fight for Valor by capturing zones and defeating opponents.
activities.descriptionZh:
“胜利的关键不是简单的占领地盘，而是清楚地知道在何时该如何将你的优势最大化。”——领主沙克斯

占领区域并击败对手，为英勇而战。

activities.name: Battleground: Hailstone
activities.description: In a bid to earn Empress Caiatl's favor, a Cabal force has descended on Europa to scour the icy moon for relics of the Golden Age including the secrets of the Exo contained in the Deep Stone Crypt. Travel to Europa and put a stop to this operation.
activities.descriptionZh: 为了获得查厄托女帝的青睐，一支卡巴尔部队来到木卫二，企图在这颗冰封卫星上搜寻黄金时代的圣物，包括隐藏在深岩墓室中与Exo有关的秘密。前往木卫二去阻止这次行动吧。

activities.name: Rushdown: Class-Based Matchmaking
activities.description: Smash your way through a curated selection of iconic encounters before the timer expires.
activities.descriptionZh: 在时间结束前，在一系列经典遭遇战中一路过关斩将。

activities.nameZh: 宗师日落: 盗劫战场：月球

activities.name: Presage: Matchmade
activities.description: Jump coordinates matching an errant distress signal.
activities.descriptionZh: 跃迁坐标与一个怪异的求救信号重合。

activities.name: Heist Battleground: Moon
activities.description: Infiltrate the Seraph bunker tucked under the dust of the Moon to reclaim fragments of the submind Malahayati's code.
activities.descriptionZh: 潜入藏在月尘之下的炽天使地堡，取回子思维玛拉哈雅提的代码碎片。

activities.name: Checkmate Survival
activities.description:
Achieve victory by depleting your opponents' shared life pool, then eliminating them.

Ability and Primary ammo damage is reduced. Special ammo is earned by engaging in combat and is not lost on death.
activities.descriptionZh:
通过损耗对手的共享生命池，然后消灭他们来取得胜利。

技能和主弹药伤害均被降低。特殊弹药需通过交战获得，死亡时不会丢失。

activities.name: Savathûn's Song
activities.description: Delve deep into the Hive-infested Arcology in search of missing fireteams.
activities.descriptionZh: 深入遭受邪魔族感染的生态园区，寻找失散的火力战队。

activities.name: Prophecy: Ultimatum
activities.description: Enter the realm of the Nine and ask the question: "What is the nature of the Darkness?"
activities.descriptionZh: 进入玖之界域，提出问题：“暗影的本质是什么？”

activities.name: Hellas Fortitude, Mars: Smuggle: Matchmade
activities.nameZh: 火星，赫拉斯坚垒：走私: 匹配
activities.description: Smuggle contraband from Hellas Fortitude, Mars.
activities.descriptionZh: 从火星的赫拉斯坚垒走私违禁品。

activities.name: Battleground: Oracle
activities.description: A group of former Red Legion Psions are communing with Vex prediction engines deep within Nessus. They seek to gain tactical insights by analyzing simulations of future events against their own psychic foresight.  Eliminate this threat before they can deliver their intelligence to Empress Caiatl.
activities.descriptionZh: 一群原属猩红军团的灵能士兵在涅索斯深处与Vex预言引擎进行交流。他们想通过分析针对他们自身灵能预感的未来事件模拟来取得战术优势。在他们将情报传回给查厄托女王之前，消灭这个威胁。

activities.descriptionZh: 前往幽梦之城逮捕逃犯奥斯里斯，并将他带回进行讯问。

activities.name: A Piece of the Past
activities.description: Return to Rasputin with the mysterious engram.
activities.descriptionZh: 带着神秘的记忆水晶回去找拉斯普廷。

activities.name: Kell's Fall
activities.description: Enter Fikrul's Revenant Fortress in the Tangled Shore, where dark reflections make it difficult to discern illusion from reality.
activities.descriptionZh: 进入费克鲁位于纷争海岸的亡魂要塞，那里的黑暗倒影让人难以分辨幻觉和现实。

activities.name: Heist Battleground: Mars
activities.description: Blitz the BrayTech Futurescape campus on Mars to repossess fragments of the submind Charlemagne's code.
activities.descriptionZh: 闪击火星上的布瑞科技未来景象园区，收回子思维查理曼大帝的代码碎片。

activities.name: Leviathan, Spire of Stars: Prestige
activities.nameZh: 利维坦，星之塔: 巅峰
activities.description: On the wings of Icarus.
activities.descriptionZh: 凌驾于伊卡洛斯之翼。

activities.name: Creation: Customize
activities.description: Protect the BrayTech facility from incursions by opposition forces.
activities.descriptionZh: 保护布瑞科技设施免受敌对势力入侵。

activities.name: Starcrossed (Legend)
activities.description: Within the Black Garden, the Sol Divisive toil endlessly, systematically shutting down potential futures. With Riven's blessing, it's time to shut them down.
activities.descriptionZh: 在黑暗花园中，太阳系分支无休止地工作着，系统性地抹除可能的未来。有了魅痕的祝福，是时候把它们抹除了。

activities.name: Destiny 2: Shadowkeep
activities.description: New nightmares have emerged from the shadows of our Moon. Called forth by haunting visions, Eris Morn has returned. Join her to slay these nightmares before they reach out beyond the Moon to cast humanity back into an age of darkness.
activities.descriptionZh: 新的梦魇自月球的阴影中浮现。受到挥之不去的幻影召唤，埃里斯·摩恩回来了。快来与她并肩作战，在梦魇自月球袭来，将人类文明拖回黑暗时代之前，把它们通通消灭。

activities.name: The Arms Dealer
activities.description: Stifle the legacy of a notorious ironmonger providing weapons to the Shadow Legion.
activities.descriptionZh: 扼杀向暗影军团提供武器的著名军械商的传承。

activities.nameZh: 远征：发射基地: 匹配
activities.description: Dig up buried pirate riches in the Cosmodrome, fight off raiders, and deliver the treasure haul to your Ketch!
activities.descriptionZh: 挖出深埋在发射基地的海盗宝藏，击退突袭者，并将宝藏堆运回你的双桅船！

activities.name: Haunted Sectors Playlist: Normal
activities.nameZh: 闹鬼区域游戏列表: 普通
activities.description: Celebrate the Festival of the Lost by exploring mysterious Haunted Sectors.
activities.descriptionZh: 通过探索神秘的闹鬼区域来庆祝英灵日。

activities.name: Battleground: Conduit
activities.description: Follow the flow of Vex radiolaria deep within Nessus.
activities.descriptionZh: 跟随涅索斯深处的Vex活性放射体液的流动。

activities.name: Contest of Elders: Matchmade
activities.description: The Warden's sadistic game, enhanced. Survive multiple laps through the prison, each one harder than the last. To the victor, more spoils await.
activities.descriptionZh: 典狱官的强化版虐待游戏。在监狱中存活多圈，每一圈比前一圈难度更高。胜者将获得更多战利品。

activities.name: Defiant Battleground: EDZ
activities.description: Rescue captives from a Shadow Legion Pyramid outpost in the EDZ.
activities.descriptionZh: 从位于欧洲无人区的暗影军团金字塔前哨站中营救俘虏。

activities.name: High Plains Blues
activities.description: Search the Tangled Shore for Cayde's killers.
activities.descriptionZh: 在纷争海岸寻找杀害凯德的凶手。

activities.descriptionZh: 伊拉莫斯激活了克洛维斯·布瑞以前建造的Vex传送门。Exo陌客请你帮忙阻止Vex入侵木卫二。

activities.descriptionZh: 与一名新盟友一起阻止抢夺行为。

activities.descriptionZh: 木卫二，帝国锻造矩阵：走私

activities.name: Guardian Games: Recreational Playlist: Standard Matchmaking
activities.nameZh: 守护者游戏：休闲游戏列表: 标准匹配
activities.description: Earn Medallions and Vanguard Medals as you compete for individual distinction and class supremacy.
activities.descriptionZh: 赢得勋章和先锋勋章，为个人荣誉和职业霸权而战。

activities.name: Adamant, Europa: Smuggle: Matchmade
activities.nameZh: 木卫二，坚固之地：走私: 匹配
activities.description: Smuggle contraband from the wind-blasted plains of Adamant, Europa.
activities.descriptionZh: 从木卫二坚固之地的风蚀平原走私违禁品。

activities.name: Road Rage
activities.description: Asher's worked up about Vex interest in the Io Vault. He's got an unusual suggestion for how to deal with the problem.
activities.descriptionZh: 阿什找出了Vex对木卫一保险库产生兴趣的原因。他用一种非常规的方法处理了这个问题。

activities.name: Battleground: Behemoth
activities.description: Empress Caiatl has deployed a tank fortress to Nessus and opened an invitation to survivors of the Red Legion to vie for a seat on her War Council. Vanquish the Cabal and prove yourself in glorious combat against her Chosen.
activities.descriptionZh: 查厄托女王在涅索斯部署了一座坦克要塞，并邀请猩红军团的幸存者前往争夺她的战争议会席位。消灭卡巴尔，在对抗她的天选者的荣耀之战中证明你自己。

activities.name: Guardian Games: Competitive Nightfall: Advanced
activities.nameZh: 守护者游戏：多人竞技日落: 高级

activities.descriptionZh: 虚无典狱官

activities.name: Lockdown
activities.description: Achieve victory by capturing and holding zones. Win rounds instantly by capturing all three.
activities.descriptionZh: 占领并防守区域，以获得胜利。占领全部三个区域将立即赢得回合。

activities.name: Fabled Mission: Charge
activities.description: Restore power to an inactive reactor to provide for the Aionian Campus.
activities.descriptionZh: 恢复一个未启用反应堆的电力，为艾昂校园提供能源。

activities.name: Mythic Mission: Charge
activities.description: Restore power to an inactive reactor to provide for the Aionian Campus.
activities.descriptionZh: 恢复一个未启用反应堆的电力，为艾昂校园提供能源。

activities.name: Vesper's Host
activities.description: Defy the algorithm. Cut through its web.
activities.descriptionZh: 对抗算法，破网而入。

activities.name: Cliffhanger
activities.description: Asher has information about the Vex's next conversion site, and he wants it stopped.
activities.descriptionZh: 阿什有关于Vex下一个转换站点的信息，他想要阻止转换的发生。

activities.name: Overthrown
activities.description: With the defeat of the Witness's forces in the Impasse, the Light flows freely once again.
activities.descriptionZh: 随着见证者的部队在僵局之地中被击败，光能得以再次自由流动。

activities.name: Will of the Thousands
activities.description: Defeat Xol before everything is destroyed.
activities.descriptionZh: 在一切被毁灭前击败尸飕。

activities.name: The Imbaru Engine
activities.description: Investigate the chamber above the Altars of Summoning.
activities.descriptionZh: 调查召唤圣坛上方的房间。

activities.name: Sundered Doctrine: Master
activities.description: Power lies in the deepest vault.
activities.descriptionZh: 力量就在最深处的保险库中。

activities.description: European Dead Zone, Earth
activities.descriptionZh: 欧洲无人区，地球

activities.name: Haakon Precipice

activities.description: Create a custom PvP match with your fireteam, and best your comrades for personal glory… and bragging rights.
activities.descriptionZh: 创建自定义PVP比赛，与火力战队和好友一起，为荣誉……和炫耀的资本而战。

activities.name: Sparrow Racing League
activities.description: The people of the City have spoken, and the Sparrow Racing League has returned. Speed your way past other Guardians in a death-defying race to the finish line.
activities.descriptionZh: 顺应圣城人民的呼声，赛雀联赛现已回归。在一场玩命竞速中，超越其他守护者，冲向终点线。

activities.name: Heist Battleground: Moon: Matchmade
activities.nameZh: 盗劫战场：月球: 匹配
activities.description: Infiltrate the Seraph bunker tucked under the dust of the Moon to reclaim fragments of the submind Malahayati's code.
activities.descriptionZh: 潜入藏在月尘之下的炽天使地堡，取回子思维玛拉哈雅提的代码碎片。

activities.name: ABHORRENT IMPERATIVE
activities.description: After an assault on Seraph Station, Rasputin is connected to the Warsat network and ready to execute his plan.
activities.descriptionZh: 对炽天使空间站发起进攻后，拉斯普廷已连接至战争卫星网络，并准备好实施计划。

activities.name: The Other Side
activities.description: Some bones live on after death.
activities.descriptionZh: 有些人死后依然活着。

activities.descriptionZh: 战场：巨兽

activities.description: Disrupt the Conductor's violent experiments to gather data on her Vex Collective.
activities.descriptionZh: 扰乱指挥者的暴力实验，收集Vex集合体的数据。

activities.name: Encore: Coda: Standard
activities.description: Put an end to the Conductor's plans to convert Sol.
activities.descriptionZh: 阻止指挥者转化太阳系的计划。

activities.name: Encore: Overture: Standard
activities.description: Investigate Maya Sundaresh's domain deep within Nessus to gain a tactical advantage against her faction of Vex.
activities.descriptionZh: 前往涅索斯深处调查玛雅·桑戴尔什的领域，获得战术优势来对抗她的Vex势力。

activities.name: Appellation
activities.description: Meet with Sloane in the place of the offering and reforge Willbreaker with Oryx's recovered hilt.
activities.descriptionZh: 在供奉之地与斯隆会面，并用找回的欧里克斯剑柄重铸碎志者。

activities.name: Strange Terrain
activities.description: Enter Hive territory and find Xol's feeding ground. Draw him out and stop him before he can surface.
activities.descriptionZh: 进入邪魔族领地，找到尸飕的供养地。将他吸引出来并阻止他重返地表。

activities.name: Birthplace of the Vile: Customize
activities.description:
Aided by the Witness, the Scorn have gained the power to break into the Throne World through areas the Light cannot touch.

Beat them back.
activities.descriptionZh:
在见证者的帮助下，嗤魅获得了从王座世界中光能无法触及的地方入侵的能力。

将他们击退。

activities.name: Nightmare Containment: Matchmade
activities.description: Draw out and defeat powerful Nightmares to imprison them with the Nightmare Harvester.
activities.descriptionZh: 引出并击败强大的梦魇，用梦魇收割者囚禁他们。

activities.descriptionZh: 登上守望塔，阻止欧顿和狂热者。

activities.name: Major Fieldwork II
activities.description: Help Eido with tonic research by participating in major fieldwork on Nessus.
activities.descriptionZh: 通过在涅索斯上参与主要外勤工作，帮助艾多进行药剂研究。

activities.name: Mission: Jailbreak
activities.description: A distress signal has been detected coming from a secret Shadow Legion prison in the EDZ. Amanda Holliday and Mithrax request your assistance in liberating the civilian captives.
activities.descriptionZh: 一个求救信号从位于欧洲无人区的暗影军团秘密监狱中传来了出来。阿曼达·霍利迪以及米瑟拉克斯请求你协力解救被关押的平民。

activities.name: Solitude

activities.descriptionZh: 火星，赫拉斯战争思维机构

activities.descriptionZh: 进入涅索斯上Vex网络的隐秘深处，阻止他们搜寻黄金时代数据。

activities.descriptionZh: 幽梦之城，灶神罗网

activities.descriptionZh: 消灭人类的敌人，收集其掉落的萤光，并将它们存放入库以召唤古昧。第一个消灭古昧的团队获胜。

activities.descriptionZh: 在金星的阿蒂西亚山追猎一名声名狼藉的不法之徒并获取其悬赏。

activities.descriptionZh: 跟随艾可拉进入奥尔特云。邀请已被发出。拭目以待吧。

activities.descriptionZh: 潜入梦境，击败加尔兰的梦魇。

activities.description: Arcadian Valley, Nessus
activities.descriptionZh: 涅索斯，阿卡狄亚谷

activities.name: Ketchcrash
activities.description: Ship-to-ship combat with the most ferocious pirates in the Sol system.
activities.descriptionZh: 与最为凶残的海盗在太阳系中进行舰对舰作战。

activities.name: Override: The Moon
activities.description: Use teamwork and your Splicer skills to force your way into the Vex network and crash it from the inside.
activities.descriptionZh: 用团队合作以及你的熔岩军团技能闯入Vex网络，从内部将其破坏。

activities.name: The Festering Core
activities.description: Descend into the heart of Io's Pyramidion and root out a burgeoning infestation.
activities.descriptionZh: 深入木卫一金字塔的核心，根除迅速发展的隐患。

activities.name: The Ordeal: Grandmaster: Warden of Nothing
activities.nameZh: 严酷考验：宗师: 虚无典狱官

activities.descriptionZh: 虚无典狱官

activities.descriptionZh: 进入拉斯普廷在发射基地的地堡，寻找安全漏洞的源头。

activities.name: Mission: Disruption: Legendary
activities.description: Evade towering Vex Minds casting a protective signal to the Collective, and find a way to bring them down to sow chaos into the Vex defenses.
activities.descriptionZh: 避开向集合体发送保护信号的高耸Vex思维，设法除掉它们以扰乱Vex防线。

activities.name: The Rifleman (Heroic)
activities.description: Avenge Cayde's death by crossing the Scorned Baron known as the Rifleman off your list.
activities.descriptionZh: 从你的报仇名单上划去名为枪客的嗤魅公爵，为凯德的死报仇。

activities.name: The Arms Dealer: Customize
activities.nameZh: 军火交易商: 自定义
activities.description: Stifle the legacy of a notorious ironmonger providing weapons to the Shadow Legion.
activities.descriptionZh: 扼杀向暗影军团提供武器的著名军械商的传承。

activities.name: PsiOps Battleground: Cosmodrome
activities.nameZh: 灵能行动战场：发射基地
activities.description: The Lucent Hive are using stolen Guardian Light for some wicked purpose. Breach their stronghold and uncover their plot.
activities.descriptionZh: 光明邪魔族用窃取的守护者光能作恶。攻破他们的堡垒，揭露他们的阴谋。

activities.name: Piker Gang Territory
activities.description:
No Bonus Active

Complete a Priority Contract in a Contested Territory to earn its Fortified Territory bonus the following day.
activities.descriptionZh:
暂无生效加成

在必争之地完成一份首要合约，即可于次日获得其强化地盘加成。

activities.name: The Devils' Lair: Customize
activities.description: Enter into the Devils' Lair and weaken the Fallen presence within the Cosmodrome.
activities.descriptionZh: 进入恶魔巢穴，削弱堕落者在发射基地的存在感。

activities.name: The Sundial: Legend
activities.description: Stop the Cabal from rewriting history and laying claim to the future.
activities.descriptionZh: 阻止卡巴尔改写历史以夺回未来的阴谋。

activities.name: Repair the Izanami Igniter
activities.description: Complete this advanced version of "The Insight Terminus" and collect a Cabal component from the boss to fully repair the Izanami igniter.
activities.descriptionZh: 完成进阶版“洞悉终界”，从首领身上收集一个卡巴尔组件来完成对伊弉冉尊点火器的修复。

activities.name: Distant Shore
activities.description: Arcadian Strand, Nessus
activities.descriptionZh: 涅索斯，阿卡狄亚滨岸

activities.name: Iron Banner Control
activities.description:
"There will come a day when the Tower falls again. Our ability to hold territory is paramount." —Lord Saladin

Capture zones to increase points for every kill.
activities.descriptionZh:
“终会有高塔再次倒塌的那天。我们守卫领土的能力至关重要。”——领主萨拉丁

占领区域以提高每次击杀所获得的点数。

activities.name: Crucible Labs
activities.description: Participate in experimental, work-in-progress Crucible experiences. For more information on Crucible Labs, visit bungie.net.
activities.descriptionZh: 快来加入正在进行的实验型熔炉竞技场试验。关于熔炉竞技场实验室的更多信息，请访问bungie.net。

activities.name: Nightfall: The Scarlet Keep
activities.description: Investigate the recently erected Scarlet Keep and discover its dark purpose.
activities.descriptionZh: 调查新近出现的猩红要塞，查明它的黑暗目的。

activities.name: Sabotaging Salvation
activities.description: Help the Vanguard destabilize what remains of House Salvation by sabotaging an important Fallen weapons factory.
activities.descriptionZh: 破坏一个重要的堕落者武器工厂，帮助先锋动摇救赎氏族仅存的根基。

activities.name: Mission: Fallow: Normal
activities.description: Go to the Agricultural Center at the Aionian Campus to eliminate the Vex sabotaging the last stable food production on Kepler.
activities.descriptionZh: 前往艾昂校园的农业中心，消灭那些破坏开普勒最后稳定食物供应的Vex。

activities.name: The Conversation
activities.description:
Enkaar, the Hive weapon master, is hiding in Hellrise Canyon in the Tangled Shore.

Hunt him down!
activities.descriptionZh:
邪魔族武器大师恩卡尔现在躲藏在纷争海岸的狱涌峡谷中。

去追捕他！

activities.description: Spider has brokered a deal. Meet the Pikers on the crime boss's barge and secure the Splicer Shank.
activities.descriptionZh: 蛛王促成了一项交易。在这名犯罪首领的驳船上会见派克组，获得熔岩军团侦察机。

activities.name: Dark Academia
activities.description:
You've stumbled across an Aionian site that's been sealed away and hidden. The shifting of the singularity has unearthed it again, revealing a grim memory.

Missed side quests imprint into Kepler's dark matter. They can be experienced later by stepping through a distorted fourth-dimensional perspective.
activities.descriptionZh:
你偶然发现了一处被封印和隐藏的艾昂场所。奇点的异动让它重见天日，揭示出一段悲惨的回忆。

错过的支线任务会印入开普勒的暗物质。你可以稍后通过扭曲的四维视角来体验它们。

activities.name: The Farm
activities.description: A refugee camp set up during the Red War for Guardians and non Guardians alike, on the outskirts of the EDZ.
activities.descriptionZh: 猩红战争期间，在欧洲无人区的市郊建立起了一座为守护者以及普通人服务的难民营。

activities.name: Cathedral of Scars
activities.description: The Dreaming City, The Vestian Web
activities.descriptionZh: 幽梦之城，灶神罗网

activities.name: Crimson Days
activities.description:
"Your partner is your life." —Lord Shaxx 

Fight alongside a teammate and work together to crush your opponents.
activities.descriptionZh:
“搭档就是生命！”——领主沙克斯

与队友并肩作战，消灭对手。

activities.name: Savathûn's Spire
activities.description: Master the magic of the Witch Queen's Spire and open the way to the Altars of Summoning.
activities.descriptionZh: 掌握巫妖女王的尖塔的魔法，开辟通往召唤圣坛的道路。

activities.name: Prophecy: Explorer
activities.description: Enter the realm of the Nine and ask the question: "What is the nature of the Darkness?"
activities.descriptionZh: 进入玖之界域，提出问题：“暗影的本质是什么？”

activities.name: The Salt Mines
activities.description: Stop new enemies from gaining a foothold in the depths of the EDZ.
activities.descriptionZh: 阻止新敌人在欧洲无人区的深处立足。

activities.descriptionZh: 调查新近出现的猩红要塞，查明它的黑暗目的。

activities.descriptionZh: 解决堕落者和邪魔族力量之间的危险冲突。
