activities.name: PsiOps Battleground: Moon
activities.description: The Lucent Hive have opened a portal between Savathûn's throne world and the Scarlet Keep. Break up the portal ritual, and prevent a full-scale invasion of Earth.
activities.descriptionZh: 光明邪魔族打开了萨瓦图恩王座世界和猩红要塞之间的传送门。阻止传送门仪式，防止他们全面入侵地球。

activities.name: Legendary PsiOps Battleground: EDZ
activities.nameZh: 传说灵能行动战场：欧洲无人区
activities.description: Guardians have recently gone missing in the EDZ. Investigate their disappearances and hunt down the Lucent Hive responsible.
activities.descriptionZh: 最近有守护者在欧洲无人区失踪了。调查他们的踪迹，并猎杀造成此问题的光明邪魔族。

activities.description: Contain a rampant army of Red Legion within the Infinite Forest.
activities.descriptionZh: 遏制无尽森林内一支肆意妄为的猩红军团军队。

activities.name: Battleground: Foothold

activities.descriptionZh: 为了报复对自身母星的毁灭，卡巴尔袭击了位于发射基地地下深处的一处邪魔族巢穴。利用这个机会给予卡巴尔沉重打击，告诉他们人类是不会退缩的。

activities.description: Feed the monster delicious treats while holding off waves of hungry hostiles. When it's full, it will engage in an incredible battle!
activities.descriptionZh: 向怪物投喂美味甜点，同时抵御一波波饥饿的敌人。等它吃饱后，就会展开一场惊天大战！

activities.name: Tharsis Outpost
activities.description: Scoundrels wheel, deal, clash, and carouse on the lawless sands of Mars.
activities.descriptionZh: 恶棍们在火星的无序沙地中纵横捭阖、械斗狂欢。

activities.name: Private Match Limited
activities.description: REWARDS ENABLED! Create a custom PvP match with your fireteam, and best your comrades for personal glory… and bragging rights.
activities.descriptionZh: 奖励已启用！创建自定义PvP比赛，与火力战队和好友一起，为荣誉…和炫耀的资本而战。

activities.name: Fallen Bunker
activities.description: Defend Earth from the Conductor's forces by claiming long-lost Golden Age salvage before they do! Jump between battlefields in the Plaguelands and Cosmodrome, fighting over the ruined husks of transport ships and abandoned spacecraft.
activities.descriptionZh: 保卫地球，抵御指挥者部队，抢先夺取失落已久的黄金时代回收物！在瘟疫之地和发射基地的战场间穿梭，争夺运输舰和废弃飞船的残骸。

activities.name: Birthplace of the Vile: Customize
activities.description:
Aided by the Witness, the Scorn have gained the power to break into the Throne World through areas the Light cannot touch.

Beat them back.
activities.descriptionZh:
在见证者的帮助下，嗤魅获得了从王座世界中光能无法触及的地方入侵的能力。

将他们击退。

activities.name: The Coil: Matchmade
activities.description: Delve ever deeper into the myriad pathways of Riven's Lair in The Coil. Face greater challenges and retrieve greater rewards.
activities.descriptionZh: 在盘蜷中深入魅痕巢穴交错的通路，面对更大的挑战，获得更丰厚的奖励。

activities.name: The Glassway: Customize
activities.description: Eramis activated the Vex portal once built by Clovis Bray. The Exo Stranger asks for your help in stopping the Vex incursion to Europa.
activities.descriptionZh: 伊拉莫斯激活了克洛维斯·布瑞以前建造的Vex传送门。Exo陌客请你帮忙阻止Vex入侵木卫二。

activities.descriptionZh: 在战斗中直面战争祭司和他的挑战。

activities.description: Enter the realm of the Nine and ask the question: "What is the nature of the Darkness?"
activities.descriptionZh: 进入玖之界域，提出问题：“暗影的本质是什么？”

activities.description: Follow Orin's guidance through a labyrinth to locate the site where the Vex refine the power of the Nine and raze their technology to ashes.
activities.descriptionZh: 跟随奥琳的引导穿过迷宫，找到Vex提炼玖之力的地点，并将其技术装置付之一炬。

activities.name: Clash

activities.descriptionZh: 击败对手以获得胜利。

activities.descriptionZh: 消灭对手或占领区域来获胜。充分利用入场券，尽可能多地获得回合及比赛胜利。

activities.name: WANTED: The Eye in the Dark
activities.description: Hunt down the wanted Eye in the Dark that was taken from the Prison of Elders.
activities.descriptionZh: 追猎逃离长老监狱的通缉犯黑暗之眼。

activities.name: Mission: Meteoric

activities.descriptionZh: 与智能失效保险重建连接，并调查位于涅索斯的异常撞击区。

Somewhere in the horrific depths of the Hellmouth lies the Hive Cryptoglyph. With it, Eris Morn can craft further Dreambane armor for your quest to find a way inside the Pyramid.

The Cryptoglyph is yours to take from the Hive… if you can.
activities.descriptionZh:
在地狱深渊之下的某处，藏有一块邪魔族秘符。有了它，埃里斯·摩恩就能打造出更多梦境祸根护甲，从而帮助你找到进入金字塔的路。

秘符正等待着你将它从邪魔族的手中夺走……如果你有这个能力的话。

activities.name: The Man Out Of Time
activities.description:
Investigate the time scars on Kepler's surface. Lodi thinks—Lodi hopes—that he might be able to go home.

Missed side quests imprint into Kepler's dark matter. They can be experienced later by stepping through a distorted fourth-dimensional perspective.
activities.descriptionZh:
调查开普勒地表的时间裂痕。洛迪认为——或者说期盼——这或许能带他回家。

错过的支线任务会印入开普勒的暗物质。你可以稍后通过扭曲的四维视角来体验它们。

activities.description: It's Brigs, Tanks, and Behemoths in a clash of heavy metal and high explosives! Smash your way to the top of the scrap heap by defeating opponents and securing the coins they drop, while recovering friendly coins to deny them to opponents.
activities.descriptionZh: 机甲、坦克，以及巨兽，重金属与高爆炸物的激烈碰撞！击败对手并收集他们掉落的硬币，同时回收友方硬币以阻止对手获得它们，一路奋战至废料堆的顶端。

activities.name: Liminality
activities.description: Carve your way through a treacherous mountain pass teeming with Lucent Hive and Taken.
activities.descriptionZh: 突破满是光明邪魔族和傀儡军团的危险山口。

activities.name: Operation: Midas
activities.description: Board the Leviathan, uncover where it has been, and learn why it has returned.
activities.descriptionZh: 登上利维坦，发现它曾经的去处，了解它为何归来。

activities.name: The Edge of Fate
activities.description: Something is calling. A message arrives that draws the Vanguard to a planetoid on the edge of the solar system. Hunt down the source of our invitation, and uncover a truth that will redefine our future.
activities.descriptionZh: 某物在召唤。先锋在收到一条信息后，来到了太阳系边缘的一颗小行星。追踪我们所收到邀请的来源，并揭开对我们未来至关重要的真相。

activities.name: Vesper's Host: Master
activities.description: Defy the algorithm. Cut through its web.
activities.descriptionZh: 对抗算法，破网而入。
